1.title: U.S. House Armed Services Committee
1.description: Welcome to the House Armed Services Committee (HASC) Youtube page.  HASC hearings are streamed live on this page and then available for future viewing.  For additional information on the HASC please visit www.armedservices.house.gov.

1.title: Full Committee Markup: FY27 NDAA, Part 2 (7pm - end of markup)
1.description:
The House Armed Services Committee will mark up H.R. 8800, the FY27 National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027 (FY27 NDAA). Learn more here: https://armedservices.house.gov/calendar/eventsingle.aspx?EventID=6601

**PLEASE NOTE: This livestream will not begin until 7pm. The beginning of the markup will stream on another broadcast - Full Committee Markup: FY27 NDAA, Part 1 (10am - 7pm) https://www.youtube.com/live/vqriCfy3zc0?si=IPT5xqoifQnLntiH

2.title: Full Committee Markup: FY27 NDAA, Part 1 (10am - 7pm)
2.description:
The House Armed Services Committee will mark up H.R. 8800, the FY27 National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027 (FY27 NDAA). Learn more here: https://armedservices.house.gov/calendar/eventsingle.aspx?EventID=6601

**PLEASE NOTE: This livestream will end at 7pm and the markup will be broadcast on another livestream: Full Committee Markup: FY27 NDAA, Part 2

3.title: SPF Subcommittee Hearing: Navy FY27 Budget Request for Seapower and Projection Forces
3.description:
The subcommittee will receive testimony from the Navy on the FY27 Budget Request for Seapower and Projection Forces

Witnesses: 
Jason Potter - Performing the Duties of Assistant Secretary of the Navy for Research, Development, and Acquisition
Lieutenant General Eric E. Austin - Deputy Commandant of the Marine Corps for Combat Development and Integration
Rear Admiral Mark Behning - Acting Deputy Chief of Naval Operations for Warfighting Requirements and Capabilities

The Seapower & Projection Forces Subcommittee is chaired by Rep. Trent Kelly (R-MS)

Learn more here:https://armedservices.house.gov/calendar/eventsingle.aspx?EventID=6580

4.title: Full Committee Hearing: Air Force FY27 Budget Request
4.description:
The House Armed Services Committee will receive testimony from the Secretary of the Air Force, Chief of Space Operations, and Chief of Staff of the Air Force on the FY27 budget request for the Department of the Air Force.

Witnesses: 
The Honorable Troy Meink - Air Force Secretary
General Kenneth S. Wilsbach - Air Force Chief of Staff
General B. Chance Saltzman - Chief of Space Operations, U.S. Space Force

Learn more here:
https://armedservices.house.gov/calendar/eventsingle.aspx?EventID=6581

The Armed Services Committee is led by Chairman Mike Rogers.

5.title: Hearing: U.S. Military Posture & National Security Challenges in the Greater Middle East & Africa
5.description:
The hearing will examine DoD policies, programs, and activities in the Greater Middle East and Africa in preparation for the FY27 NDAA. Members will assess the threats to U.S. national security in the region and evaluate the effectiveness of the Department’s use of the resources provided by Congress to defend our nation.

Witnesses: 
Assistant Secretary of Defense for International Security Affairs Daniel Zimmerman
USCENTCOM Commander Admiral Brad Cooper, USN
USAFRICOM Commander General Dagvin Anderson, USAF

The Armed Services Committee is led by Chairman Mike Rogers


Learn more here:
https://armedservices.house.gov/calendar/eventsingle.aspx?EventID=6576

6.title: Full Committee Hearing: Army FY27 Budget Request
6.description:
The House Armed Services Committee will receive testimony from Army Secretary Dan Driscoll and Acting Army Chief of Staff General Christopher LaNeve on the Army's FY27 budget request. 

Witnesses: 
Secretary of the Army Daniel P. Driscoll
General Christopher C. LaNeve, Acting Army Chief of Staff

Learn more here:
https://armedservices.house.gov/calendar/eventsingle.aspx?EventID=6575

The Armed Services Committee is led by Chairman Mike Rogers.

7.title: CITI Subcommittee Hearing: Science, Technology, and Innovation Posture of the Department of Defense
7.description:
The hearing will cover  DoD's science and technology activities; technology development, test and evaluation, and transition; and the Department’s collaboration with industry, academia, and interagency partners. 

Witnesses: 
Emil Michael - Undersecretary of Defense for Research and Engineering
Owen West - Director, Defense Innovation Unit
Cameron Stanley - Chief Digital and AI Officer

The Cyber, Information Technologies, and Innovation Subcommittee is led by Chairman Don Bacon (R-NE). 

Learn more here: https://armedservices.house.gov/calendar/eventsingle.aspx?EventID=6466

263.title: 20210520 CITI Hearing: "Reviewing DOD S&T Strategy, Policy, and Programs for FY2022"
263.description:
At 11:00am ET on May 20, 2021, the Subcommittee on Cyber, Innovative Technologies, and Information Systems will meet to receive testimony on the Fiscal Year (FY) 2022 President’s Budget Request for Department of Defense’s Science and Technology (S&T) programs; activities; infrastructure; and policies, including alignment with national strategies and interagency efforts, to maintain technological superiority. Additionally, the hearing will provide members an opportunity to examine the roles, responsibilities and authorities of the Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering, and the Military Departments’ Assistant Secretaries responsible for research, technology, and development, in accordance with Title 10, United States Code. The subcommittee will focus on their responsibility to lead a robust science and technology ecosystem of agencies; offices; laboratories; federally funded research and development centers; university affiliated research centers; academic partnerships; test and evaluation entities; and partnerships with the private sector, to include small businesses, to deliver the best capabilities to the warfighter in the near, mid, and long-term.

265.description:
On May 18, 2021, the Subcommittees on Readiness and Seapower and Projection Forces will convene for a joint hearing. Areas of discussion will focus on: sealift policy including the Maritime Security Program and the potential for a Tanker Security Program; sealift recapitalization requirements; the status of our Merchant Mariners; inter- and intra-theater airlift requirements; aerial refueling requirements; the Civil Reserve Air Fleet program; surface distribution requirements; and the Defense Personal Property Program including the future Global Household Goods Contract.

Learn more: https://armedservices.house.gov/hearings?ID=0A99A54E-7A89-423F-99E3-3F0F2B13AAB9

266.title: 20210514 CITI Hearing: “Operations in Cyberspace and building Cyber Capabilities Across the DOD"
266.description:
At 11:00am ET on May 14, 2021, the Subcommittee on Cyber, Innovative Technologies, and Information Systems will meet to receive testimony on military operations in cyberspace and building cyber capabilities across the Department of Defense. The hearing will provide members an opportunity to examine the strategy, policy, and programs for operations in cyberspace and U.S. Cyber Command. Additionally, the witnesses will provide testimony on major legislative initiatives and policy issues related to cyber. The hearing will allow members to assess and examine the policies, authorities, and guidance for the conduct of cyber operations in respective mission areas, as well as notifications to Congress, the establishment in Departmental policy of the Cyber Operational Forces, integration and coordination with Geographic and Functional Combatant Commands, and any changes in cyber mission priorities over the past two years. Additionally, the subcommittee will hear about the implementation of additional authorities and responsibilities granted in the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2021 (Public Law 116-283).

Learn more: https://armedservices.house.gov/hearings?ID=A29B4BAE-E25A-4ABF-B0AF-8C1F089EF2E0

1.title: Ranking Member Smith on Trump Rolling Out the Red Carpet for China, Toll of Iran War
1.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined CNN's Erin Burnett Wednesday night to talk about the VIP treatment Trump showed to Chinese President Xi Jinping and also the toll the Iran war is taking on U.S. service members, including the Acting Secretary of the Navy saying that there were eight sailors who attempted suicide across the entire strike group since the start of the USS Lincoln's record-long deployment for Trump's disastrous war against Iran.

2.title: Ranking Member Smith on the Latest in Iran and Trump and Xi meeting on CNN
2.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Kasie Hunt on CNN on Tuesday to talk about the latest in Trump's disastrous war against Iran and the need for the president to work with President Xi to help curb conflict, including in the AI space.

3.title: HASC Ranking Member Smith on why he is voting against the FY27 NDAA
3.description:
The FY27 NDAA is critically important legislation that includes key Democratic priorities like protecting collective bargaining, expanding reproductive health care, and requiring transparency on the Minab girls school bombing, the costs of Trump's war against Iran, and his ongoing boat strikes in SOUTHCOM. 

The problem begins with the $1.6 trillion price tag...

- House Armed Services Comittee Ranking Member Adam Smith

4.title: Untitled   July 21, 2026 at 17 53 48
4.description:
We had a fair process and robust debate on the FY27 NDAA in Committee. That is not the case on the House floor today. None of the Democratic amendments on controversial issues, including the $1.6 trillion price tag or Trump's disastrous and ongoing war against Iran, are being allowed, silencing the opportunity for meaningful debate.

- House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith

5.title: Smith on MSNOW: This is the most dangerous time our country has been in in a long time
5.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member joined Chris Hayes on MSNow to talk about President Trump's continued war against Iran in spite of the massive losses to U.S. service members' lives, military equipment, and the U.S. and global economies.

"This is the most dangerous time I think our country has been
 in a long time because we have a president who is unhinged. He is not 
connected to reality. And that's bad because he's conducting a war. Service members are dying. The world is becoming more unstable, and he's not even really paying attention to it."

6.title: Smith on CNN: There's no strategy coming from Trump on Iran and he's dragging us over a cliff.
6.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Erin Burnett on CNN Monday night to talk about the latest reports the Pentagon failed to notify Congress about 100 U.S. Service Members wounded in action in Trump's war against Iran in the past two weeks and the rising death toll, which includes four Amerian service members killed over the weekend in Jordan and Iraq. 

Smith said, "We need to end this war and get the best negotiated peace we can get, and that's not going to be great at this point because we've given Iran so much leverage by starting the war, showing them they can control the Strait of Hormuz. Now, as far as what Trump's going to do, I don't know. He's talking about Kharg Island, talking about revenge ... there's no strategy, there's no plan, there's no vision in there. Look, I said this last week, I think the resident has reached the point where he's just not fit for office. He doesn't know what he's doing, and he's dragging us into an endless conflict. So I hope the Republicans will speak up and push him in a different direction because right now he's just headed over a cliff.

7.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN Talks About Graham's Passing Impacting Support for Ukraine and Iran
7.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Kate Bolduan on CNN Monday morning to talk about the potential impact on support for Ukraine and sanctions against Russia in light of Sen. Lindsey Graham's sudden death. They also discussed the latest on President Trump's threats to have the U.S. take over the Strait of Hormuz, which was open until he launched his disastrous and illegal war of choice against Iran.

8.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on CNN: I have no confidence in Sec Hegseth to protect the Constitution
8.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Jake Tapper on CNN on Friday and they discussed Trump's recent actions, including firing Democratic Members of the bipartisan Election Assistance Board and what that may mean if Trump were try to overthrow another election as he attempted to do in 2020.

9.title: Ranking Member Smith Discusses Trump's War Against Iran on The Source with Kaitlan Collins
9.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined Kaitlan Collins on CNN to talk about the latest developments in Trump's disastrous war of choice against Iran.

10.title: Ranking Member Smith on News Nation: Trump Must Negotiate an End to His Disastrous War Against Iran
10.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined host Leland Vittert and guest ret. Gen. Philip Breedlove to discuss Trump relaunching his war of choice against Iran and threats of further military action, with Smith arguing that Trump has yet again stumbled into a situation that requires a diplomatic solution and can't be won the battlefield alone.

11.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on MSNOW: Trump is not connected to reality
11.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) spoke about President Trump's dangerous and delusional twisted version of reality and how that has led to his disastrous war of choice against Iran, threatened to break the NATO alliance, and has put U.S. national security at extreme risk.

12.title: 20260709 Smith CNN Jim Sciutto
12.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined Jim Sciutto on CNN on Thursday to discuss the Trump's disastrous war of choice against Iran and failure to negotiate a peaceful end to the conflict that Trump started, which requires diplomacy to end not more military engagement.

13.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN: Trump is politicizing the military for his own needs.
13.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Erica Hill on CNN's Out Front on Friday. They discussed the recent arrest of a U.S. Air Force major for protesting Trump's disastrous policies on the steps of the U.S. Capitol. They also talked about an op-ed published by ret. Gen. C.Q. Brown, who was fired as Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff by Secretary Hegseth last year, in which Brown wrote, "The military must protect the respect that it has earned from American society by scrupulously following all lawful orders and by demonstrating every day that it is nonpartisan. In so doing, service members honor the oath they swear, not to a particular party or political leader, but to the Constitution itself."

14.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on CNN:
14.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined John Berman on CNN Tuesday morning to discuss the recent briefing from the Trump Administration on the Trump's war against Iran which revealed the U.S. is still having to negotiate to open the Strait of Hormuz, which was open before Trump started his war, and that the administration has failed to reach an agreement on Iran abandoning its nuclear ambitions.

15.title: Ranking Member Smith:
15.description:
"We cannot afford a $1.6 trillion defense budget. We just can't."

House Armed Services Committee Democrats Ranking Member Rep. Adam Smith delivering opening remarks in today's House Rules Committee meeting on the FY27 NDAA.

16.title: RM Smith on CNN: Ending the war is the right call, we'll see how the negotiations play out.
16.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Anderson Cooper on CNN Monday to discuss the negotiations between the U.S. and Iran to end Trump's war of choice and Trump's claims that the agreement includes requiring Iran to buy "food ... exclusively through the United States from our farmers.

17.title: Ranking Member Smith on NPR: Trump's war was a colossal mistake that needs to end.
17.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) spoke with NPR's Steve Inskeep earlier this morning about the state of negotiations between the U.S. and Iran and the certainty that whatever agreement is reached will be worse than the JCPOA.

"The war ... was a colossal mistake. ... Now Iran knows they have the Strait of Hormuz as a major leverage point, and their regime is every little bit as hard line, and their nuclear weapons program is not going away... . But let's get to a better place. We need to stop this war. So, I hope the negotiations can lead to that," Ranking Member Smith said.

18.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on MSNOW: Trump has empowered Iran
18.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Alex Witt on MSNOW to talk about the failure of President Trump's war of choice against Iran and the fact that memorandum of understanding between the U.S. and Iran achieves none of the Trump Administration's stated goals for the war and instead provides Iran with a $300 billion reconstruction fund to open the Strait of Hormuz, which was open before Trump launched his predictably disastrous war.

19.title: Ranking Member Smith on the U.S.-Iran MoU on NewsMax: There is no deal here.
19.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash) joined Rita Crosby and NewsMax to discuss the U.S.-Iran MoU and to dispel the myth that the agreement has achieved anything for American interests by simply bringing us back to the point where we were before Trump's disastrous war began and by weakening America's position in the face of the $300 Billion reconstruction fund Iran is getting in exchange for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, which was open before the war started. 

"Militarily, Iran has been degraded, but their ability to hold the strait
 at risk, to hold the region at risk, is still there. ... Degrading them doesn't necessarily help us if it doesn't have a strategic effect. Iran is still able to support their terrorist organizations, and they've been lobbing missiles at various countries throughout the region. That has massively disrupted the global economy. And now they know that they have the Strait of Hormuz as a leverage point. They didn't have that prior to this war. And so now we have to 
negotiate over that. ... How can we say this is better than some deal that came before when it doesn't even exist at the moment, and Iran has not 
changed anything about their nuclear program?" Rep. Smith said.

20.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN: If Trump Had Unlimited Power Iran Wouldn't Have a Nuclear Program
20.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Laura Coates on CNN Thursday night to discuss details of the 14 point memorandum of understanding between the U.S. and Iran to end Trump's disastrous war of choice and the staggering level of capitulation Trump has shown Iran, weakening America's national security and world standing.

21.title: Ranking Smith on CNN: US-Iran Negotiations and Navigating Diplomatic Hurdles
21.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Laura Coates on CNN Thursday night to discuss details of the 14 point memorandum of understanding between the U.S. and Iran to end Trump's disastrous war of choice and the staggering level of capitulation Trump has shown Iran, weakening America's national security and world standing.

22.title: Ranking Member Smith: Trump's Disastrous War with Iran Accomplished Nothing, Weakened the U.S.
22.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Connell McShane on NewsNation to discuss the U.S.-Iran memorandum of understanding which saw President Trump capitulating to Iran to end the war he started that has accomplished nothing other than giving Iran more leverage and weakening America's position.

23.title: Ranking Member Smith on AC360: No matter how Trump's war ends, Iran will be in a stronger position
23.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined Anderson Cooper on CNN Monday night to talk about the pending agreement between Iran and the U.S. to end Trump's disastrous war of choice and what the terms of the agreement entail.

24.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN: Trump dodging releasing MOU because he doesn't want to admit the truth.
24.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined CNN's John Berman Tuesday morning to talk about what the reasons might be for Trump's refusal so far to release the MOU with Iran.

"... This agreement basically is just an effort to stop the war and open up the strait because of the incredible pressure on the global economy... .It's certainly impacting us, but it's impacting the entire globe. And the president wants that to stop. So that's what the focus of this is. But what about the nuclear program? What about the ballistic missile program? What about the support for terrorist groups? All the things that President Trump promised us were going to be accomplished by this war, which very clearly have not been accomplished by this war. So he's trying to keep it vague... ," Ranking Member Smith said.

25.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on MSNOW: Hoping for peace w/Iran, but Trump's war was "colossal mistake."
25.description: House Armed Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined the MSNOW weekend prime time program to discuss the latest news on a possible agreement between the U.S. and Iran to end Trump's disastrous war of choice against Iran.

26.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN: Trump's Iran War Accomplished Nothing
26.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Omar Jimenez on CNN Sunday night to talk about the breaking news that the U.S. and Iran have possibly reached an agreement to end Trump's devastating war of choice, though many details of the final agreement remain unknown.

27.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN: Everyone is losing in Trump's war against Iran.
27.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined CNN's Brianna Keilar on Friday afternoon after several sources in the region said there has been some progress on the possibility of a deal between Trump and Iran to end his disastrous war of choice. Smith noted the comments from others are a good sign, but it's too soon to tell for certain, and that everyone needs the war to end immediately.

28.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN: Trump is using weasel words to make Iran deal seem imminent.
28.description:
"Any deal that is even as good or much less better than what Obama had negotiated,  and Trump stupidly tore up, that's just not on the table right now. And  Trump's trying to obfuscate in a thousand different ways so that we don't see that."

House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) on The Lead Jake Tapper on CNN.

29.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on CNN: I don't believe Trump's claim of Iran deal.
29.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Jake Tapper on The Lead on Thursday to talk about the president's claim that he has reached a deal with Iran to end Trump's war of choice. Smith also talked about why he doesn't trust Trump's choice for DNI.

30.title: Ranking Member Smith Introduces Amendment to Defund Trump Battleship Vanity Project
30.description:
We cannot afford a $20+ billion battleship that doesn't meet our defense needs, especially in light of our fiscal reality.

- House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.)

31.title: Smith Calls out GOP Claiming Fiscal Conservatism While Exploding Debt w/over $1T Defense Budget
31.description:
"This is what it would take to raise $250 billion over ten years. ... We're increasing the defense budget or trying to ... by $500 billion this year alone. ... We're driving ourselves into the ground and ... we should stop."

- House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.)
 offers and withdraws tax increase amendment for the FY27 NDAA to force Republicans claiming they're fiscally conservative to contend with the Trump Admin driving up the national debt with out of control spending, including its $1.15 trillion defense budget.

32.title: Ranking Member Smith: Get the hell out of here with over $1T defense budget.
32.description:
If you don't want to raise taxes, OK, but then get the hell out of here with the over $1 trillion defense budget.

- House Armed Services Committee Democrats Ranking Member Rep. Adam Smith offers and withdraws a $200 billion a year tax increase amendment in the #fy27ndaa in the face of the Trump Admin's $1.15 trillion defense budget on top of the $4 trillion in national debt and while gutting health care, education, and food assistance programs.

33.title: Ranking Member Smith Kicks Off House Dems' Fight Against Trump's $1.15 Trillion Defense Budget
33.description:
The base text of the FY27 NDAA care of our troops and continues the committee's work to improve the quality of life of our service members and their families. It continues our work on acquisition reform. And it reflects our strong bipartisan support for partners and allies. The problem starts with the money.

- House Armed Services Committee Democrats Ranking Member Rep. Adam Smith leads off House Democrats' fight to rein in the Trump Admin's out of control spending and increases to the national debt, including a staggering $1.15 trillion defense budget.

34.title: RM Smith on Trump Using DOJ to Attack E. Jean Carroll: Unbelievable and Unprecedented Abuse of Power
34.description: U.S. Rep Adam Smith (D-Wash.), Ranking Member of the House Armed Services Committee, joined Anderson Cooper on CNN Wednesday night to discuss Trump's latest weaponization of the Department of Justice to attack former magazine writer E. Jean Carroll, who accused Trump of sexual assault and who has won defamation cases against Trump and millions of dollars in damages related to his attacks of her character and discussing the assault.

35.title: Ranking Member Smith to Asst Sec Def Zimmerman: Is Trump Misinformed or Making it Up on Iran?
35.description:
"(Trump)_ has repeatedly said that Iran has agreed to things that they obviously have not agreed to. ... Is the president misinformed? ... Is he that ignorant about the circumstances? Or is he just making it up...?"

- House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) questioning Assistant Secretary of Defense Zimmerman about Trump's false claims about the status of his war against Iran.

36.title: 20260520 Smith AF Budget Opener Captioned
36.description:
"We have Critical shortages in munitions and capabilities. How do we innovate faster and get to scale? ... The Air Force and the Space Force are crucial to that. (But) we also have a debt at over 100% of GDP ... How do we achieve our objectives in a more cost effective manner?"

- House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) delivers opening remarks in today's full committee hearing on the U.S. Air Force FY27 budget request.

37.title: Ranking Member Smith Asks Why Trump Admin Refuses to Admit it Mistakenly Hit Girls School in Iran
37.description:
"It's been 80 days... since the bombing campaign that struck the girls school in Iran (and) killed over 150 schoolgirls. ... Can you at this moment acknowledge that mistake was made and we were responsible for it? It's something we didn't want to do and don't want to repeat?"

- House Armed Services Committee Democrats Ranking Member Rep. Adam Smith questioning Admiral Brad Cooper, Commander of U.S. Central Command on why the Trump Admin refuses to acknowledge U.S. responsibility for bombing a girls school in Iran.

38.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN: Don't Believe the Trump Admin on China or Iran
38.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Laura Coates on CNN Thursday night to talk about Trump's trip to China and claims of deals with President Xi and Iran without any evidence.

39.title: Ranking Member Smith: Unrealistic to ask for a 50-60% increase in defense budget given U.S. debt
39.description:
"Innovating at scale is at the core of what we're trying to do... and we need to do it in a cost-effective way. ... (I)t is highly unrealistic to ask for a 50-60 percent increase in the defense budgets when we have our debt to GDP ratio over 100%, and we continue to cut taxes and reduce our revenue in a thousand different ways to the tune of trillions of dollars. That just doesn't add up and, past a certain point, that is a national security threat to this country."

- House Armed Services Committee Democrats Ranking Member Rep. Adam Smith speaking at the FY27 Army Budget Request hearing.

40.title: Ranking Member Smith at Navy Budget Hearing: We Can't Just Spend Our Way Out of Problems
40.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) speaking in today's full committee hearing on the FY27 Navy Budget Request talked about seeing U.S. Sailors and Marines consistently perform at the highest level no matter the challenges thrown at them. And Congressional initiatives and investment have resulted in real progress in improving our shipbuilding capacity and encouraging innovation for revitalizing our defense industrial base. But many challenges remain and we cannot simply spend our way out of the remaining problems.

41.title: WATCH: Ranking Member Smith Grills Sec Hegseth on Trump Admin's Incompetence in Iran, Throughout DoD
41.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) questioned Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth on Trump's disastrous and costly war of choice against Iran and the chaos unleashed at the Department of Defense by the Trump Administration's strategic incompetence and incoherent ambiguity.

42.title: Ranking Member Smith on MSNOW: The actual cost of Trump's Iran War closer to $100 Billion
42.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Chris Hayes on MSNOW on Friday night to talk about the reality of Trump's disastrous war of choice against Iran, including the real cost and the fact that it shows no sign of slowing down or stopping.

43.title: Ranking Member Smith on MSNOW: Trump's War With Iran Continues to Exact Terrible Toll
43.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined MSNOW's The Weekend to discuss Trump's ongoing and disastrous war of choice against Iran and that there is no evidence to support the president's numerous claims about the ceasefire and the U.S.'s position. 

"President Trump wants to act like words and facts no longer matter. ... The truth is, words and facts do still matter. Trump tries very hard, and frankly, it scares me the degree to which he is successful in fooling people into thinking that they don't, but they do, and the truth of what's going on right now is that we are stuck, because Iran doesn't want to negotiate about what we want to negotiate. ... It's not a ceasefire, we've just moved from a war where Trump thought bombing would achieve objectives to a war (with) a blockade, which, by the way, is an act of war. We're doing less shooting, but it's not a ceasefire. And those are the facts.

44.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on On Balance: Facts Do Matter
44.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Leland Vittert on NewsNation Friday night to discuss Trump's disastrous war of choice against Iran and that there is no evidence to support Trump's claims regarding the war, which shows no sign of stopping and has left the U.S. in a weaker position with Iran that it was before Trump launched the war.

45.title: Ranking Member Smith: We're weaker than before Trump started his war, don't know where it's going.
45.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined NPR Morning Edition's Leila Fadel on Friday to talk about the latest on Trump's war of choice against Iran, noting that the U.S. is in a weaker position than we were before Trump started his war and his conflicting and untrue claims make it hard to know where the war is going.

46.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on CNN: We are nowhere close to an agreement with Iran.
46.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined CNN's Laura Coates Thursday night to discuss the conflicting messages coming out of the White House with regards to Trump's war of choice against Iran and his remarks that directly conflicted with Secretary Rubio's comments about the alleged ceasefire.

47.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Explains How NATO Works to Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth
47.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) explained to Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and others in the full committee hearing earlier this week on the Trump Administration's request for a $1.4 trillion defense budget for Fiscal Year 2027 amid Trump's disastrous war of choice against Iran that shows no sign of ending and has already cost the American taxpayers' tens of billions of dollars.

48.title: Ranking Member Smith Grills Sec Hegseth About Contradictory Claims for Reasons for Trump's Iran War
48.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) questioned Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth bout his contradictory claims for the reasons behind Trump's disastrous war of choice against Iran.

"We had to the start the war, you just said, 60 days ago because the nuclear weapon was an immanent threat. Now you're saying it was completely obliterated."

49.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Delivers Opening Remarks at Hearing with Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth
49.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) delivered opening remarks in today's full committee hearing on the FY27 Defense Budget Request, and asked Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth about the lack of coherent strategy from the president, the secretary or the Trump Administration.

"Our troops have preformed incredibly well in the past 15 months... the problem is the strategy that has been put before us. ... I've heard you give speeches about how realism is our strategy, and I find that absurd given what we are doing," Ranking Member Smith said.

50.title: Department of Defense Claims Iran War Cost is $25 Billion
50.description: It was good to finally get a number on the cost of Trump's war against Iran from Department of Defense. Now we need to know what this number includes and, more importantly what it doesn't cover, like damaged or destroyed equipment and systems.

51.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith: Trump Has Been Lying About What Iran is Saying for a Long Time
51.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Jake Tapper on CNN Tuesday night to discuss the latest on Trump's disastrous war of choice against Iran and continued assault on basic constitutional rights and the truth in regard to his statements regarding the war he started and his attacks on critics and those who disagree with his version of reality.

52.title: Ranking Member Smith on Hegseth's First Appearance Before Congress Since Iran War Began
52.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined MSNOW's Weekend Prime Time with Ayman Mohyeldin, Catherine Rampell, and Elise Jordan on Sunday night to talk about the latest developments in Trump disastrous war of choice against Iran, and what Smith and HASC Democrats expect to hear from Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth when he testifies before the committee, marking the first time since Trump launched the war.

53.title: Ranking Member Smith on Iran, Hegseth on MSNOW with Charles Coleman
53.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Charles Coleman Jr on MSNOW on Saturday to talk about the latest on Trump's disastrous war of choice against Iran and what HASC Democrats want to hear from Secretary of Defense Hegseth when he testifies before the committee on Wednesday.

54.title: Ranking Member Smith Discusses Latest on Iran, Hegseth with Major Garrett
54.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Marjor Garrett on The Take Out to talk about the latest on Trump's disastrous war of choice against Iran and what he and HASC Democrats expect to hear from Secretary of Defense Hegseth in Wednesday's hearing, in which he's expected to request $1.45 trillion for defense spending.

55.title: Ranking Member Smith Discusses Latest on Iran, Hegseth on CNN
55.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined John Berman on CNN Monday morning to talk about the latest on Trump's disastrous war against Iran and what HASC Democrats expect to hear from Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth when he testifies before the committee on Wednesday on the White House request for $1.45 trillion for defense spending.

56.title: Ranking Member Smith Delivers Opening Remarks at Full Committee INDOPACOM Posture Hearing
56.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) in his opening remarks at today's full committee posture hearing on the Indo-Pacific region talked about how the region is crucial to our national security  and peace and stability across the globe and key to maintaining that security and stability is our ability to provide significant deterrence through the strength of our military and by working with allies and partners throughout the region.

57.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith: Trump is Nowhere Close to Ending War He Started with Iran
57.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Jessica Dean on CNN's PrimeTime Weekend show Sunday night to discuss the latest on Trump's war of choice against Iran and the fact that the president is still no closer to finding an end to the war that has already exacted staggering costs - both in terms of economic losses and lost lives -- for the U.S., allies and partners, and Middle Eastern region.

58.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith: Both Sides Are Stuck in Trump's War With Iran
58.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Brianna Keilar on CNN Monday afternoon to discuss the latest developments in Trump's war against Iran noting that both sides seem to be stuck as Trump continues to try and find an off-ramp to a war that he started and that has so far resulted in the Strait of Hormuz being closed and controlled by Iran and no significant progress made in any of the president's strategic goals, including regime change and elimination of Iran's nuclear program.

59.title: RM Adam Smith on News Nation: Trump Putting Forces in Position to Have Boots on the Ground in Iran
59.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined NewsNation's Anna Kooiman on Sunday afternoon to talk about the latest developments with Trump's war against Iran and his continued amassing of U.S. forces in the Middle East region and escalated threats that could result in U.S. troops on the ground if the faltering ceasefire fails.

60.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith: President who doesn't know what truth is leading us into devastating war.
60.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Anderson Cooper on CNN Thursday to talk about the latest briefing from the Pentagon that included a senior U.S. official saying Iran still retains thousands of missiles, one-way attack drones, and threats capable of hitting allied forces throughout the region.

"It shows what a lot of us said from the start: This was a very stupid decision to launch this war. Now, we just have to hope that the president figures out some way to get out of it and minimize the costs going forward," Ranking Member Smith said.

61.title: Ranking Member Smith: Trump's Threats to Obliterate Iran Are Completely Unhinged
61.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash). joined NPR's Morning Edition with host Leila Fadel Tuesday morning to discuss President Trump's escalating threats to obliterate Iran. "Further  escalation would only up the cost of the war. It would not put us any  closer to accomplishing any sort of strategic objective... . This approach just is going to make a lot more people suffer in the Middle East and globally."

62.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN: Trump's war is wrong, but I support our service members.
62.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Brianna Keilar on Out Front to talk about the latest developments in Trump's disastrous war of choice against Iran, including the Iranians downing at least two U.S. jet fighters and one U.S. service member still missing. 

"I want to make clear I support our service members. I support 
our troops and my thoughts and prayers are absolutely with the 
service members who are at risk and at danger every day, and 
particularly the one that has been been lost after this plane was shot 
down. ... My feelings about the war don't change my incredible support for our service members, and we all need to be rooting and praying that he is returned home safely. But ... it fundamentally changes the equation if the Iranians have an American service member hostage that totally changes the negotiations, it gives them another leverage point and leverage point ... and makes it more difficult to resolve this conflict," Ranking Member Smith said.

63.title: Smith on CNN: We've Seen No Meaningful Change in the Iranian Regime
63.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) spoke with John Berman on AC 360 Monday night about the state of President Trump's ongoing war of choice against Iran, and that the president has yet to show the tactical successes of the U.S. military's bombing campaign have had any meaningful impact on the Iranian regime and whether it can build a nuclear weapons program, ballistic missiles, and support terrorist proxy groups that continue to destabilize the region.

64.title: Ranking Member Smith: US Worse Off Than Before Trump War Started
64.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Lawrence O'Donnell on MSNOW Tuesday night to about the latest on Trump's war of choice against Iran and the fact that the United States is actually worse off than before the war started. 

"We are worse off than when we started... the costs of this war (include) the 13 service members killed, the hundreds wounded, the thousands of civilians killed, the impact on the global economy, one more severe fracture to our alliance as we saw NATO country after NATO country abandoning trump's war today."

65.title: Ranking Member Smith on Trump's War of Choice with Iran on Morning Joe: Trump is Clueless.
65.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined Joe and Mike on Morning Joe Monday to talk about the ongoing war of choice Trump launched in Iran over a month ago and that has engulfed the entire Middle East region with no signs of ending due to Trump's inability to plan ahead or learn from the lessons learned in previous wars in Afghanistan, Iraq, and Libya. 

"This is why Trump is so clueless, Trump only has one move... he comes in, he punches you in the face, gets you to submit, and then gets what he wants. That's the move he's got," Smith said. "Well, he came in, he punched Iran in the face, they looked back at him and said, we're still here. What's his move now?"

66.title: Ranking Member Smith on Morning Joe:
66.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Morning Joe on Monday to discuss the latest on President Trump's war of choice with Iran and the continued lack of a coherent strategy and plan to meet the conflicting objectives from Trump and his administration and lack of transparency or engagement with Congress and the American people.

67.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Joins Laura Coates on CNN to Discuss DHS Shutdown
67.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Laura Coates on CNN Friday night to discuss Speaker Johnson's refusal to bring up the Senate-passed bipartisan bill to end the government shutdown and provide funding for TSA, FEMA, and the Coast Guard. and minus funding for ICE until reforms can be instituted to ensure ICE doesn't continue to violate basic constitutional rights and laws in a way that resulted in the deaths of two Americans in Minneapolis.

68.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN: There is bipartisan concern about where Trump's War in Iran is Headed
68.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Brianna Keilar on CNN Wednesday following a classified briefing on Operation Epic Fury and discussed the shared frustration among Members of Congress from both sides of the aisle on the Department of Defense and Trump Administration's lack of clarity about the objectives the war, whether ground troops will be deployed, if there are force protection plans in place, and a host of other critical questions that remain unanswered four weeks into the war of choice Trump launched against Iran without congressional approval.

69.title: Ranking Member Smith on The Last Word: Trump Doesn't Know Where He's Going with Iran War
69.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Lawrence O'Donnell on The Last Word on Monday night to talk about President Trump's continuing lack of clarity and plan for his war against Iran and the catastrophically high cost the war will extract the longer Trump refuses to end the military campaign.

70.title: Ranking Member Smith Discusses Iran War, DHS Funding on NewsMax's Sunday Report
70.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined News Max's Jon Glasgow on Sunday Report to discuss congressional Republicans refusing to allow a vote on Democrats' solution to fund everything in DHS but ICE for the past four weeks and President Trump's ill-planned and disastrous war in Iran that has resulted in the deaths of 13 American service members, thousands of civilians - including 150 Iranian school girls - and skyrocketing fuel and others costs that threaten to topple the U.S. and global economies.

71.title: Ranking Member Smith on News Nation: Global, US Economy Will Suffer As Long As Trump's War Continues
71.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined NewsNation to talk about the impact of Trump's war in Iran on the American and global economies.

72.title: Ranking Member Smith on News Nation: Trump is Creating More Chaos, Death, Devastation with His War
72.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Natasha Zouves on News Nation Sunday night along with Rep. Kevin Kiley (I-CA) to talk about the President Trump's disastrous war in Iran, his threats against Cuba, and the fallout of those and other shambolic actions on U.S. and global security and economy.

73.title: Ranking Member Smith:
73.description:
“If we did not have troops in Europe, if that alliance was gone … how would have that have impacted what we’ve been able to do in Iran? “

House Armed Services Ranking Member Adam Smith asking the Supreme Allied Commander of U.S. European Command, Gen. Alexus Grynkewich, to break down the important assistance NATO has provided to the U.S. in Iran.

74.title: Ranking Member Smith: Are we committed to the NATO Alliance?
74.description:
“This shouldn’t be hard for you. Are we committed to the NATO alliance? … Because despite what we’ve heard from the White House, I think it is an incredibly beneficial thing for United States of America.”

House Armed Services Ranking Member Adam Smith asking Assistant Secretary of Defense Daniel Zimmerman if the U.S. remains committed to NATO, our long-standing and most successful military alliance.

75.title: Ranking Member Smith: How Does President Trump Belittling and Threatening NATO Impact the Alliance?
75.description:
“How does it impact the strength of the alliance for the president to keep saying he wants to walk away from it, to keep threatening and belittling our allies, threatening to make Canada the 51st state, threatening Greenland and to take it away from Denmark? How does that impact the strength of the alliance?”

House Armed Services Ranking Member Adam Smith asking Assistant Secretary of Defense Daniel Zimmerman about President Trump’s threats to NATO and the risk that poses to U.S. national security and defense in Iran and elsewhere.

76.title: Ranking Member Smith: NATO Alliance Led to U.S. Being Richest, Most Powerful Nation
76.description:
“The NATO alliance led to the United States of America being the richest, most powerful nation in the history of the world. … I think that was a substantial benefit to us. Yes, it also benefited Europe and NATO. But that’s what a partnership is about—mutual benefit.”

House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith in his opening remarks for the full committee hearing on the U.S. Military Posture and National Security Challenges in Europe

77.title: Ranking Member Smith Opening in U.S. Military Posture and NatSec Challenges in Europe Hearing
77.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) delivered his opening remarks at Wednesday's full committee hearing on the U.S. military posture and national security challenges in Europe with Assistant Secretary of Defense Daniel Zimmerman and Supreme Allied Commander Gen. Alexus Grynkewich.

78.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith: There's No Way Trump Wasn't Briefed on Possible Retaliation for Iran War
78.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith spoke with Anderson Cooper on CNN Tuesday night about the fact that DoD has been briefing presidents and Members of Congress for over a decade about the risks of going to war with Iran, in spite of Trump's claims to Fox News that he wasn't told of any possible retaliation.

79.title: Ranking Member Smith on AC 360: NATO Allies Are De-Risking America
79.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Anderson Cooper on CNN Tuesday night to discuss the fallout of Trump's war against Iran, including the lack of support from NATO allies.

80.title: Ranking Member Smith on AC 360: Trump Briefed on All Possibilities with Iran, Chose to Ignore it
80.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Anderson Cooper on CNN Tuesday night to talk about Trump's specious claims to Fox News that he wasn't briefed on the retaliation risks associated with his war against Iran and the fallout of Trump's fight with NATO allies for not wanting to join his likely illegal war.

81.title: Ranking Member Smith Asks Trump Official If He Has Any Proof Boat Strikes Are Keeping Drugs Out
81.description:
“Do you have any measurable facts that show fewer or less drugs are getting into the U.S.?”

Ranking Member Adam Smith asking if the Trump Administration has any evidence that it's lethal strikes on alleged drug boats has stopped drugs from coming into the U.S.

82.title: RM Smith on MSNOW: It's Disgusting The Way Hegseth, Trump Admin is Trivializing the War
82.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined MSNOW's panel of hosts on The Weekend Primetime to talk about the lack of seriousness, honesty or transparency with which the Trump Administration is treating the Iran war and the risks that poses to U.S. service members and the region.

83.title: Ranking Member Smith on MSNOW: Trump Has No Clear Strategy for Winning Iran War
83.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) spoke with the Rev. Al Sharpton on MSNOW Sunday about the lack of strategy or path laid out by Trump or his administration in achieving total degradation of Iran's military and regime change, even as the death toll of U.S. service members and innocent civilians continues to rise in the Middle East.

84.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN: Trump Admin Dove Into War Without Clear Plan, Target List
84.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Laura Coates on CNN Thursday night to talk about the Trump Administration's handling of the war Trump started against Iran and their lack of planning for inevitable consequences and fallout.

85.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN: The Cost of Trump's Iran War is Deadly, Expanding Rapidly
85.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Erica Hill on Out Front Friday night to discuss the latest on Trump's war against Iran and it's rapid expansion into the Middle East and high costs in terms of lives lost, military equipment destroyed, and rising oil prices.

86.title: Ranking Member Smith on MSNOW: Trump Still Failing to Clearly Set Goals, Endpoint for Iran War
86.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Chris Hayes on MSNOW on Friday night to talk about the ongoing lack of a coherent strategy or off-ramp to Trump's war against Iran and the very real possibility that Trump will put boots on the ground in Iran despite the vast majority of Americans opposition to that and his deadly and costly war.

87.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN: We've weakened Iran, but at enormous cost.
87.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Dana Bash on CNN on Wednesday to talk about the escalating costs of Trump's war in Iran and the lack of evidence that the threat from Iran has been eliminated, particularly when it comes to Iran's nuclear capabilities.

88.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on CBS: Threat From Iran Reduced, But at a Very High Cost
88.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Major Garrett on CBS on Wednesday to talk about Trump's war in Iran and the lack of transparency on the cost and losses, and whether those costs and losses are enough to justify what is a temporary reduction in threats from Iran.

89.title: Ranking Member Smith on MSNOW: Trump Admin Isn't Providing Cost Analysis, Basic Info on War in Iran
89.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Lawrence O'Donnell on the The Last Word Wednesday night to discuss  Trump's war in Iran, the lack of information being provided to Congress or the American people -- including the cost of the war and other campaigns like the bombing of alleged drug boats in the SOUTHCOM region -- and how Democrats could use legal means to require the Administration to provide answers if Dems reclaim the majority in Congress this year.

90.title: RM Smith on CNN: Fallout from Trump's War in Iran was Predictable
90.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Anderson Cooper on Sunday to talk about the predictability of the fallout from the failures of the Trump Administration to pay attention to warnings provided well in advance of Trump's war against Iran. 

"All of this was unbelievably predictable... we've been  examining this problem through multiple different administrations. ... I was told repeatedly that there wasn't a military solution to Iran's nuclear program, that you couldn't eliminate it just with an air campaign. ... The Iranian regime is dug in. It isn't just one guy at the top controlling everything. There are layers upon layers upon layers. They have the guns. They have the forces. We all knew this. Donald Trump chose to not pay any attention to it for some reason."

91.title: Ranking Member Smith Discusses Latest on Trump's War Against Iran on the BBC
91.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined the BBC's Ros Atkins to discuss President Trump's war of choice with Iran and the implications for the U.S., the region, and partners and allies worldwide.

92.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Discusses Trump's War in Iran on NewsMax
92.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined NewsMax's Saturday Agenda to discuss President Trump's war in Iran, his lack of a coherent plan and end goal, and the risks that presents to American service members and others in the region, as well as the national security and economy of the United States, allies, and friends.

93.title: Ranking Member Smith on MSNOW: War Should be Last Resort, Not First Option
93.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Ali Veshi on MSNOW on Saturday to discuss Trump's war in Iran, which has engulfed the Middle East in conflict, and his failure to learn from past mistakes in Iraq, Afghanistan, and elsewhere.

94.title: Ranking Member Smith on NewsNation: War with Iran Has Impacts on U.S. National Security and Defense
94.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Natasha Zouves on NewsNation Sunday night to discuss the impacts that Trump's war in Iran could have to the national security and national defense of the United States and allies and partners, including in the Indo-Pacific with China and Taiwan and in Europe as Putin continues to attack Ukraine.

95.title: The Whole Story With Anderson Cooper - Rep  Adam Smith
95.description: House Armed Services Ranking Member Adam Smith joined Anderson Cooper Sunday night to talk about Trump's disastrous war in Iran and the need for congressional Republicans to join Democrats in forcing Trump to withdraw from the conflict.

96.title: Ranking Member Smith: Trump Doesn't "Have a Clear Plan" for War In Iran
96.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Alex Witt on MSNOW on Sunday to discuss the latest on President Trump's war in Iran, which has engulfed the Middle East and threatens the stability of the region and safety and security of American service members and civilians as well as the U.S. and global economies.

97.title: Ranking Member Smith on NewsMax with Greta Van Susteren
97.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined Greta Van Susteren on NewsMax Sunday to talk about the lack of a coherent plan or strategy in Trump's war in Iran, which has engulfed the Middle East and threatens the safety and security of American service members and civilians as well as allies and partners.

98.title: RM Smith Discusses Trump's War Against Iran on The Hill Sunday
98.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Chris Stirewalt on The Hill Sunday to talk about the problems with President Trump's war in Iran, including its predictable spread throughout the Middle East, and what that means for the safety and security of American service members and civilians in the region, here at home, and our partners and allies in the region.

99.title: Ranking Member Smith on Fox 13 Seattle: GOP in Congress has Decided to Back Trump's War in Iran
99.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Fox News 13 Seattle Friday morning about Trump's war in Iran and Republicans in the House and Senate voting to back the war despite Trump's promise to end wars on the campaign trail.

100.title: Ranking Member Smith on The Brief With Jim Sciutto
100.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Jim Sciutto on CNNi Thursday night to talk about the latest on Trump's war in Iran and firing of Kristi Noem.

101.title: Sequence 04 1 1
101.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith questioned Under Secretary for Defense Policy Elbridge Colby in today's full committee hearing about Trump reneging on his promise to end all wars. 

"How did the America First agenda fail in Iran? Because I think the president sincerely meant... if you put me in office, I'm going ... to make sure we don't go to war with Iran. He failed. We're at war with Iran & 14 other countries have been dragged into it.

102.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Asks Trump Official What is the Plan in Iran
102.description: House Armed Services Ranking Member Adam Smith questioning Undersecretary for Defense Colby in today's full committee hearing asked:  "What does success look like in Iran? What are the objections we are trying to achieve...? How do we know we are on plan...? The lack of specifics are troubling, particularly in terms of how long this is going to go on."

103.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Delivers Opening Remarks at Full Committee Hearing on NDS
103.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith asked Undersecretary for Defense Policy Elbridge Colby to explain the National Defense Strategy and the Trump Administration's values and how those square with Trump's campaign promises to end forever wars and the reality of the expanding war in the Middle East and U.S. military assaults in Africa, South America, and elsewhere since Trump assumed office.

104.title: Ranking Member Smith Opening Statement at Full Committee DIB Hearing
104.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) delivered opening remarks at the full committee hearing today focused on revitalizing the defense industrial base.

"What we need to do is innovate faster and get to scale. ... We've made some progress on that front both in terms of what the Pentagon is doing and what we did here in Congress. I really want to compliment and thank the chairman for his leadership on acquisition reform that we passed last year. ... But clearly there's a lot more work to be done," Ranking Member Smith said.

105.title: Ranking Member Smith on Trump Launching War Against Iran Without a Plan
105.description:
"We have U.S. civilians trapped in the Middle East being told to leave, meanwhile the airports are shutdown. Hezbollah and Israel are now back in a full-scale conflict. It's spiraling out of control with no clear plan how to have an off-ramp."

House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith discussing Trump's lack of planning despite launching a war against Iran that has engulfed the Middle East.

106.title: Ranking Member Smith Discusses Trump's Failure to Justify War in Iran on News Nation
106.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Chris Cuomo and Rep. Pat Fallon (R-TX) on News Nation Monday night to discuss Trump's failure to lay out a coherent justification and provide evidence for launching a war in Iran that has engulfed the Middle East, and the lack of evidence for claims that Iran presented an imminent threat to the United States.

107.title: Ranking Member Smith Discusses Latest on Trump War in Iran on NewsNation
107.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Leland Vittert on NewsNation Saturday to discuss the latest on President Trump unilaterally launching a war of choice with Iran absent congressional approval and the implications for American national security, service members, and the Middle East region.

108.title: Ranking Member Smith: Defense Dept Hasn't Spoken to  Congress Since Iran Attack
108.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Katy Tur on MSNOW Saturday night to talk about Trump's launch of a full scale war in the Middle East without congressional approval and that even after the attack began "the Department of Defense hasn't spoken to a 
single solitary member of Congress since this attack happened."

109.title: Ranking Member Smith: Trump Iran war is largest mil op launched without justification or approval
109.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Katy Tur on MSNOW Saturday to discuss Trump's unleashing of a full scale war in the Middle East absent congressional approval, and the risks of that action to American service members and their families, as well as the stability of the entire region.

110.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Discusses Why He Won't Attend SOTU, Trump's Threats Against Iran

115.title: RM Smith Discusses Munich Security Conference, Iran, and DHS on MSNow
115.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Alex Witt on MSNow Sunday to discuss the latest developments on the U.S. possible carrying out another military strike against Iran, the Munich Security Conference, and Secretary Noem's threats against voting rights.

118.title: Ranking Member Smith Warns of Dangers of Forcing Regime Change in Iran

House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined Kate Bolduan on CNN early Monday where they discussed the danger of the Trump Administration trying to force regime change in Iran as called for by Sen. Lindsey Graham. 

"... (Y)ou can't just change it. it is incredibly complicated and dangerous. What comes next? How will the regime react? That's the big concern right now and why we're moving so many assets to the region. Iran still has missiles. If we attack them in some way, we have bases, we have allies in the region who would be vulnerable to that. So I am deeply worried that President Trump is going to take a much more aggressive stance, well, frankly, than he said he was going to do during the campaign and drag us into another endless foreign war."

120.title: Ranking Member Smith Discusses Trump Threats to Greenland, NATO on News Nation Part Two

122.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Katie Pavlich on News Nation Monday night to talk about President Trump's first year in office, which included adding $4 trillion to the national debt, stripping health care coverage from millions of Americans, and trampling American's fundamental rights in Minneapolis and other so-called Blue cities and states across the country despite the fact that the president has said repeatedly that the U.S. border is secure.

127.title: Ranking Member Smith on MSNOW: We no longer live in a constitutional republic.

139.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined MSNOW on Saturday to talk about Trump's policy in Venezuela and the threats it poses to stability in the region and also U.S. national security.

It's about might makes right in his belief that the U.S. ought to be in control of everything. ... He's got sympathy for Putin. Putin's got his sphere of influence. - Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) speaking with Sara Sidner on CNN about what Trump should do if he really wants to help end Putin’s war in Ukraine.

151.title: Ranking Member Smith: The US Should Not Be Forcing Regime Change in Venezuela

Smith talked about the flaws in the policy from the standpoint of eliminating illicit drugs in the U.S., as claimed by the admin, as well as the more likely scenario that this is an attempt to force Maduro out and for Trump to assert dominance in the Western Hemisphere.

152.title: Ranking Member Smith: "Hegseth is Flat Out Lying" About Excuse Not to Release 2nd Strike Video.
152.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined MSNOW's Ana Cabrera Wednesday morning before a full committee classified briefing on the follow-on boat strike on Sept. 2 that killed two survivors clinging to the wreckage of a burning boat and adrift at sea. 
When asked what he made of Hegseth's claim that the video of the follow-on strike couldn't be released due to classified information in spite of Hegseth releasing over a dozen other boat strike videos, including as recently as today, and leaking sensitive military plans ahead of action in the Signalgate scandal earlier this year.

Smith said, "We all know that Secretary Hegseth is perfectly comfortable with releasing sensitive information, as we saw during the Signalgate scandal, but let's give him that point. What you can do is what they've done over and over again since September 2nd and released the video of the first strike. There is nothing classified, nothing sensitive about the roughly 30 seconds where you see the two people on the boat before the (second) strike hits. He is flat out lying to say that that is classified top secret information that he can't possibly release."

153.title: Ranking Member Smith on AC 360 - Hegseth Needs to Release Second Strike Video, Execute Orders
153.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Anderson Cooper Wednesday night following a full committee classified briefing with Adm. Bradley on the follow-on strike from September 2nd that killed two survivors left clinging to the burning wreckage of a boat and adrift at sea. Smith said it appears Trump is pushing the operation not to address the flow of illicit drugs into the U.S. but to carry out regime change in Venezuela and to assert dominance in the Western Hemisphere. Smith also noted the dishonesty of Secretary Hegseth's claims that the double-tap boat strike video can't be released because it's classified in light of Hegseth releasing yet another boat strike video today in which four people were killed.

154.title: Ranking Member Smith: The Trump Administration Should Release the Second Boat Strike Video

"I think the American people ought to be able to see for themselves ... . The full video of this contact is 5.5 hours. I  don't expect him to release all 5.5 hours. ... But the strike itself is not classified ... . They know if the public sees it, it will make it clear that they are not being honest about what happened," Ranking Member Smith said.

160.title: Ranking Member Smith Urges Passage of FY26 NDAA
160.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith spoke in support of the FY26 NDAA on the House floor today, urging support of the bipartisan bill that delivers the most significant acquisition reforms in a generation. It includes a 3.8 percent pay raise for service members, extends efforts to improve childcare and military housing, and protects civilian workers from arbitrary reductions in force. It invests in science and technology and shows allies and partners that the U.S. still stand with them. And it reasserts congressional authority by ensuring funding for Ukraine and European security cooperation and exercising oversight of the lethal U.S. military boat strikes in the SOUTHCOM region.
