179.title: Ranking Member Smith on Investigation Into Reports of Follow Up Strike, Trump Intimidation Tactics
179.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Charles Coleman on MSNOW Sunday morning to discuss the bipartisan House investigation into recent reports that Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth ordered follow up strikes in one of nearly a half dozen unauthorized lethal U.S. military strikes on boats suspected of carrying narcotics in the SOUTHCOM region. They also discussed Trump and Hegseth targeting six Democratic Members of the House and Senate who are veterans of the military or intel services who put out a video repeating the UCMJ code for unlawful orders and the chilling effect it's meant to have on anyone who wants to speak out against the current administration.

180.title: RM Smith on MSNOW: Trump Policies Are Make us Weaker on Ukraine and Russia and More
180.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Katy Tur on MSNBC to talk about the Trump Administration's botched handling of ongoing negotiations for a potential peace agreement with Ukraine and Russia and the policies overall weakening the U.S. in the eyes of China, Russia, Iran and the world.

181.title: RM Smith: Witkoff's "Huge Mistake" on Call with Russia
181.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Boris Sanchez on CNN on Wednesday to talk about the leaked call between Trump's Special Envoy, Steve Witkoff, and Putin's Foreign Policy Advisor, Yuri Ushakov, contributes to a pattern of weakness on the part of the Trump Administration and its ability to deal with Putin's invasion of Ukraine and Russian aggression in Ukraine and Europe.

182.title: RM Smith: The U.S. Showing Strength with Ukraine is How We Get a Peace Deal.
182.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined News Nation's Leland Vittert along with retired four-star Gen. Philip Breedlove, who served as the commander of U.S. European Command, as well as the 17th Supreme Allied Commander Europe (SACEUR) of NATO Allied Command Operations.

183.title: Smith, Fine Join Cuomo to Discuss Trump's Lethal Boat Strikes, Threats to Venezuela
183.description: House Armed Services Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) and Rep. Randy Fine (R-Ariz.), member of the House Committee on Foreign Affairs, joined Chris Cuomo on News Nation Wednesday night to discuss the legality of Trump Administration's lethal U.S. Military strikes on boats suspected of carrying drugs in the Eastern Pacific and Caribbean and Trump's threats of regime change and invasion of Venezuela. They also discussed the House's vote to release the Epstein files and efforts to censure both Democratic and Republican Members of Congress.

184.title: Ranking Member Smith: On Epstein, Venezuela, Foreign Wars, Trump Campaigned Lying to America
184.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined John Berman on CNN Monday morning to talk about Trump's threats of regime change in Venezuela, his politicization of the release of the Epstein files, and his attempts to undo the massive damage he has wrought on America's economy. 

"(W)hether it's Epstein, Venezuela, you know, foreign wars -- Trump campaigned, it seems at this point, basically lying to the American people," RM Smith said.

185.title: Ranking Member Smith on MSNBC:
185.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Alex Witt on MSNBC on Sunday to talk about the lack of clarity and information from the Trump Administration in regard to its use of lethal U.S. military strikes on boats alleged to be carrying drugs in the Caribbean and Pacific, and whether or not the massive buildup of military presence in the region signals plans for the invasion of Venezuela to force regime change. Smith and Witt also spoke about Trump's abuse of the Department of Justice to exact revenge and to provide a distraction from evidence of his own close involvement with child sex trafficker Jeffrey Epstein.

186.title: Ranking Member Smith on Meet the Press NOW: Rubio Denied Plans for Regime Change in Venezuela
186.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined NBC's Garrett Haake on Friday to talk about Operation Southern Spear, the ongoing lethal bombing campaign of small boats alleged to be carrying cocaine in the Caribbean and Pacific, and whether the build up of U.S. military presence in the region signals a possible land invasion and attempt to force regime change in Venezuela.

187.title: Ranking Member Smith on Lethal Boat Strikes: Likely Illegal, Costly, and Ineffective
187.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Leland Vittert on News Nation Friday night to talk about the consequences of the Trump Administration's use of lethal U.S. military strikes on dozens of small boats in the Caribbean and Pacific alleged to be carrying drugs. "I think it's illegal and I don't think it's going to help much in the drug war, costs a lot of money, places us at risk, undermines us with our allies," Smith said.

188.title: Ranking Member Smith on MSNBC: No Evidence Provided for Use of Lethal U.S. Military Boat Strikes
188.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Katy Tur on MSNBC on Monday to talk about the recent Gang of 16 classified briefing with Secretary of State Marco Rubio regarding the Trump Administration's continued use of lethal U.S. military strikes on alleged drug boats in the Caribbean and Pacific. Smith noted the lack of evidence provided in the briefings, including who the 24 designated terrorist organizations identified as such by Trump are, and the lack of legal justification for using deadly military force on suspected drug couriers who would normally be handled through interdiction.

189.title: Ranking Member Smith: No Legal Justification, Evidence Given for Deadly U.S. Military Boat Strikes
189.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Jackie Alemany, Jonathan Capehart, and Eugene Daniels on MSNBC's The Weekend on Sunday morning after a classified briefing was held for House Armed Services Committee Members on the Trump Administration's ongoing lethal U.S. military campaign targeting alleged drug boats in the Caribbean and Pacific. Ranking Member Smith noted that no legal justification was provided in the briefing nor has any intelligence been provided to Congress to explain who is being targeted in the deadly attacks or has been unilaterally designated by Trump as so-called narco terrorists.

190.title: Smith, Jim Sciutto Discuss Trump Withholding Snap, Ordering Deadly Military Strikes in South America
190.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Jim Sciutto on The Source on CNN Friday night to discuss President Trump's refusal to disburse SNAP benefits despite Congress making the funds available, a federal court ordering that he do so, and Trump authorizing the payments in his first term in the government shutdown in 2019. 

They also discussed the President's continued deadly bombing campaign of small boats alleged to carry drugs in the Caribbean and Pacific and the lack of evidence for those claims or legal justification for use of kinetic strikes for drug crimes as well as recent reports that Trump is about to launch a ground war in Venezuela.

191.title: Ranking Member Smith:
191.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined Laura Coates on CNN Thursday night to talk about the bipartisan frustration with the lack of information being provided by the Trump Administration for the evidence and justification of its orders of lethal U.S. military strikes on alleged drug boats and the president's recent remarks about increasing U.S. nuclear weapons testing.

192.title: Ranking Member Smith:
192.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Kate Bolduan on CNN Friday morning to discuss the latest on the Trump Administration using lethal U.S. military strikes on alleged drug boats in the Caribbean and Pacific and the continued lack of explanation for the legal justification for carrying out lethal strikes rather than interdictions as well as the Administration's failure to meaningfully brief Congress and provide evidence and intelligence to support the need for such military operations.

193.title: Ranking Member Smith: China and US Need to Figure Out How to Coexist
193.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Leland Vittert on News Nation Wednesday night to discuss President Trump's announcement that he’s ordered the Department of Defense “to start testing our nuclear weapons on an equal basis.”

194.title: Ranking Member Smith on MSNBC: Mike Johnson has Dissolved the U.S. House of Representatives
194.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Charles Coleman on MSNBC Sunday afternoon to discuss the ongoing impacts of the Republican government shutdown and Speaker Mike Johnson's refusal to convene Congress and negotiate an end to the stalemate or take up legislation to ensure U.S. Service Members and federal works can get paid.

195.title: Ranking Member Smith: Republicans Refuse to Negotiate End to Shutdown
195.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Jon Glasgow on News Max Sunday morning to talk about the ongoing impacts of the Republican shutdown and Speaker Johnson's refusal to convene congress and negotiate with Democrats to end the stalemate.

196.title: Ranking Member Smith Discusses Lethal US Strikes and Increase of US Military in Southern America
196.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member joined Brian Entin on News Nation Friday night to discuss the utter lack of evidence of who is being hit and who is being killed in the lethal U.S. military boat strikes in the Caribbean and Pacific and the implications of the drastic military build up Trump has ordered in the region and possibility of attempting a ground war and regime change.

197.title: Ranking Member Smith Questions Legality of Lethal Military Boat Strikes on CNN with Kaitlan Collins
197.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Kaitlin Collins on CNN's The Source Friday to talk about the serious legal and ethical questions of the Trump Administration's lethal military strikes on alleged drug boats in the Caribbean and Pacific and the implications stability and possible war in the region.

198.title: Ranking Member Smith on NPR: U.S. Military Boat Strikes Raise Questions of Legal Military Orders
198.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Rep. Adam Smith joined NPR Morning Edition Host Michel Martin to to discuss lethal U.S. Military strikes on alleged drug boats in the Caribbean and Pacific and serious questions regarding the lack of the Trump Administration's legal justification or evidence for the deadly campaign.

199.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on Meet the Press Now
199.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined Kristen Welker on Meet the Press NOW to talk about

200.title: Ranking Member Smith: Trump Has Provided No Proof for Lethal Military Strikes
200.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Major Garrett on CBS on Wednesday to talk about the lack of transparency on what the United States is doing in the Southern Command region and zero proof provided for using lethal U.S. military force on alleged drug boats. He also spoke about the abrupt departure of the combatant commander in charge of Southern Command amid questions of the legality of these orders.

201.title: Ranking Member Smith: Lethal Boat Strikes are Part of Trump's Authoritarian Takeover
201.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Charles Coleman on MSNBC's The Beat on Friday to talk about President Trump's ongoing campaign of using U.S. military force on small boats in the Caribbean and Pacific his administration claims is carrying illegal drugs. Dozens have been killed with no evidence provided to back Trump Administration's claims and the campaign is part of a broader effort by Trump to consolidate power and conduct an authoritarian takeover of the U.S. government.

202.title: Ranking Member Smith on CNN: Shutdown Hurts Americans and Congress' Ability to Conduct Oversight
202.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Laura Coates on CNN Tuesday night to talk about the impacts of the Republican shutdown on the American people and on Congress' ability to conduct oversight over issues such as Trump ordering lethal U.S. military strikes on boats off the coast of Venezuela.

203.title: Ranking Member Smith: U.S. Military Boat Strikes are Illegal
203.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Laura Ingle on News Nation on Saturday to discuss the illegal U.S. military boat strikes off the coast of Venezuela, Trump's meeting with Zelenskyy on Friday, and why Speaker Johnson attacking peaceful protests is both wrong and dangerous to our democracy.

204.title: Smith Discusses Republican Shutdown, Hamas and Israel, US military Strikes in the Caribbean
204.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Alex Witt on MSNBC Sunday afternoon to discuss the Republican shutdown and Speaker Johnson's refusal to call the House into full session to work out a solution; the latest on Israel and Hamas and the tenuous peace agreement; and Trump's illegal military strikes on boats off the coast of Venezuela that have killed more than two dozen people without providing any evidence of Trump's claims of terrorism or an imminent threat to the United States.

205.title: RM Smith on CNN: Trump' Needs to Keep the Pressure on Putin to End His War in Ukraine
205.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Brianna Keilar on CNN Friday afternoon to talk about the cabinet meeting with President Trump and President Zelensky and also the impacts of the Republican goverment shutdown on federal workers, including those in national security and defense jobs facing furloughs.

206.title: Ranking Member Smith on News Nation: U.S. and China Need to Coexist
206.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Blake Burman on News Nation to talk about the need for China and the U.S. to worth together to coexist peacefully and the need for the Trump Administration to work with Israel and Arab partners to ensure a future for the Palestinians as part of the peace agreement.

207.title: Ranking Member Smith on Troop Deployments to U.S. Cities and Shutdown Impacts
207.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined News Nation's Natasha Zouves on Saturday to talk about the problems with President Trump ordering U.S. troops into U.S. cities that Trump views as Democratic and Trump's threats to fire Democratic federal workers and falsely blaming Democrats for the government shutdown even as Republican Speaker Mike Johnson refuses to call Congress back to session or negotiate to end to the shutdown.

208.title: RM Smith on Latest on Israel / Hamas Peace Plan and Troop Pay in a Government Shutdown
208.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Blake Burman on News Nation to talk about the latest news on the Hamas/Israel peace plan and that he would vote for providing pay for U.S. troops during the government shutdown if legislation were brought to the floor.

209.title: Ranking Member Smith on MSNBC: We've Always Negotiated During Shutdowns
209.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Ali Velshi on MSNBC Sunday morning to call out Speaker Johnson's false claim that negotiations can't occur during a government shutdown.

"We always negotiate during shutdowns. That's the whole point. ... (I)t doesn't even make sense what he's saying. We have to agree to what the republicans want before they will talk to us? Look, if you wanted negotiate health care subsidies, if you wanted to negotiate tax policy, if you wanted negotiate anything, you could do it right now. In past shutdowns, Congress has been in session voting. The Republicans this time have shut it down, sent us home and said, 'we're not going to talk to you.' So, what Mike Johnson is saying makes no sense whatsoever. We should be negotiating right now."

210.title: Ranking Member Smith: Trump and Hegseth Pep Rally Weakens our National Security
210.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Ali Velshi on The Last Word to discuss the fallout of Hegseth and Trump's rambling and incoherent pep rally that both wasted vast amounts of money, time, and resources while weakening us in the eyes of both allies and adversaries around the world.

211.title: Ranking Member Smith Joins News Nation to Discuss Latest on Republican Government Shutdown
211.description: U.S. Representative Adam Smith (D-Wash.), Ranking Member of the House Armed Services Committee, joined News Nation today to discuss the latest impacts of the Republican-led government shutdown.

212.title: Ranking Member Smith Discusses Republican-led Government Shutdown on News Nation - Part 2
212.description: Part Two of U.S. Rep. Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joining Chris Cuomo, and Rep. Mike Haridopolos on News Nation Thursday night to discuss the impacts of the Republican-led government shutdown.

213.title: Ranking Member Smith Discusses Republican Shutdown with Chris Cuomo on News Nation
213.description: Part One of U.S. Rep. Adam Smith (D-Wash.), Ranking Member of the House Armed Services Committee, Chris Cuomo and U.S. Rep. Mike Haridopolos (R-Fla.) discussing the impacts of the Republican-led government shutdown on News Nation.

214.title: Ranking Member Smith on U.S. Military Strikes Off the Coast of Venezuela and Gaza
214.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined MSNBC's Erielle Reshef on Tuesday to discuss the latest on President Trump ordering the the U.S. military to carry out a second deadly strike on a small boat off the coast of Venezuela and the war in Gaza. Ranking Member Smith has led National Security committee democrats in speaking out against Trump's dangerous expansion of executive branch power and, in the process, weakening American national security twice this week. Those statements can be found here, https://democrats-armedservices.house.gov/press-releases?ID=EEE89403-B5B0-49BA-A144-66DBF3A2FC99, and here, https://democrats-armedservices.house.gov/press-releases?ID=FB26303D-912F-41F8-BB80-13F18F10E3FD.

215.title: Ranking Member Smith on Latest on Russia Provoking NATO allies, Gaza, and Venezuela Boat Strike
215.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Ali Velshi on MSNBC Saturday morning to discuss the latest on Russia's unjust and brutal invasion of Ukraine, including incursion into NATO airspace in Poland and Estonia; Israel ramping up the violence and war with its attacks in Qatar; and Trump's gross executive overreach and likely illegal lethal military strike on a speed boat off the coast of Venezuela that allegedly carried drugs.

216.title: Ranking Member Smith: Violence is never acceptable.
216.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Katrina Szish on American Agenda on NewsMax Friday to talk about political discourse in the United States in the wake of the fatal shooting of Charlie Kirk.

217.title: Ranking Member Smith: Transgender Attacks Have No Place in Defense Authorization Bill
217.description: "The transgender community has been targeted and discriminated against aggressively. ... None of these amendments are remotely necessary. They are an effort to take advantage of a culture war partisan issue to drive a wedge into this bill. It doesn't belong here," House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith speaking on the House floor against a series of Republican amendments to the #fy26ndaa attacking the Transgender community, including denying all gender-affirming medical care for children of U.S. service members.

218.title: Rep Garamendi: Erosion of Defense Policy Seen in Partisan Process
218.description: "I want to thank my Republican colleagues, particularly the Chair, Mr. Rogers, for your efforts in committee to put together a decent bill, which I did vote for. However, I'm seriously alarmed by some of the things in the bill and that even more likely to occur today. It's the erosion of our defense policy's lack of fiscal discipline, strategic clarity, and constitutional boundaries. ... Please, if you have a chance, take it in a different direction," HASC Readiness Subcommittee Ranking Member John Garamendi speaking about passage of the FY26 NDAA as altered on the House floor.

219.title: Ranking Member Smith: Politicization of the military is undermining our constitutional democracy
219.description: "Politicization of the military (is) undermining our constitutional democracy. I think we need to exercise oversight of that. We had a number of amendments that would have at least given this chamber the opportunity to debate ... they were all silenced," House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith on the partisan rules process that has undermined the 65-year bipartisan tradition of the National Defense Authorization Act by failing to allow debate on core policy disagreements or include meaningful amendments offered by Democrats to address critical issues.

220.title: Ranking Member Smith: Leadership Has Abandoned Bipartisan Process on NDAA
220.description: "The process we went through in committee was a model for how to legislate on the National Defense Authorization Act and in bipartisan fashion. ... What came out of the Rules Committee ... abandoned everything Chairman Rogers and everybody put in the committee process... . Leadership decided to make this a partisan exercise instead of an exercise focused on the American service members, their families, making sure that our country has what it needs to meet our national security and defense needs," House Armed Services Committee Minority Ranking Member Adam Smith speaking on the House floor about the Fiscal Year 2026 National Defense Authorization Act.

221.title: Ranking Member Smith: Trump is Weakening the U.S. and Thinks He Can Lie About It
221.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Ali Velshi on The Last Word Friday. They talked about Trump ordering a military strike on a motor boat off the coast of Venezuela and Trump's lies about his disastrous domestic and foreign policies, which are weakening the United States and placing us as greater economic and physical peril.

222.title: Ranking Member Smith on BBC: Calls for U.S. to Stop Some Weapons Sales to Israel
222.description:
House Armed Services Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined BBC News to discuss his latest statement calling for President Trump to directly appeal to Prime Minister Netanyahu to implement a ceasefire and increase the flow of humanitarian aid into Gaza and also stop expansion settlements in the West Bank. If Israel doesn’t heed that call the U.S. government needs to stop the sale of some offensive weapons systems to Israel.

Read Rep. Smith's statement here: https://adamsmith.house.gov/news/press-releases/rep-smith-calls-us-leverage-certain-arms-sales-israel

223.title: Ranking Member Smith: Crime is a problem. Fascism isn't the answer.
223.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) talks about President Trump deploying the military in Washington, D.C. and other American cities as a clear hallmark of fascism and not the way to address crime in urban or local areas.

224.title: Ranking Member Smith: We Need More Police to Reduce Crime, Not Military
224.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined News Max's American Agenda on Tuesday to talk about the deployment of National Guard and other federal agencies to Washington, D.C. Smith agreed that crime is a problem in many U.S. cities, including so-called Red cities, and it should be addressed, but using the military in place of domestic law enforcement is unconstitutional.

225.title: Smith on MSNBC: Trump Meeting with Zelensky Disappointing But Could Have Been Worse
225.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Lawrence O'Donnell on MSNBC's Last Word to talk about the disappointing lack of results from Trump's meeting with Zelensky and European leaders, but noted it wasn't as bad as the meeting with Putin.

"Trump didn't make it worse, but the missed opportunity with Putin to have, as you described, some moral clarity and to hold Putin to account, put some pressure on Putin. Here we are, how many months into the Trump presidency, and there's no pressure on Putin, which gives him an excuse to keep prosecuting this war."... It was great that the European leadership was there today to show a united front and to make it more difficult for Trump to go off the rails... but you still didn't have the moral clarity you needed to put the pressure on Putin to force him to the table and end this war," Ranking Member Smith said.

226.title: Ranking Member Smith: Trump Promising Ukraine Security is Good, Still a Long Way to Go
226.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Boris Sanchez on CNN today to talk about President Trump saying he the U.S. will provide Ukraine with security guarantees, noting it's a positive development but the lack of clarity shows there is still a long way to go for ensuring U.S. support for Ukraine remains strong.

227.title: Ranking Member Smith: Damage Done By Trump in Putin Meeting Sets Back Prospects for Peace
227.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) spoke with Alex Witt on MSNBC Sunday to talk about the damage Trump did to the peace process between Ukraine and Russia when he rolled over for Putin and allowed him to rewrite the narrative of the brutal war of aggression that Putin has wrought on Ukraine. Smith also underscored the critical importance for Trump and the administration, which has tried to walk back some of that damage, to make clear its support for Ukraine in today's White House meeting.

228.title: Ranking Member Smith on Trump Meeting With Zelensky, Gaza, Federalization of D.C. Police
228.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined News Nation's Chris Stirewalt to discuss the upcoming meeting with President Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, the humanitarian crisis in Gaza, and the federalization of law enforcement in Washington, D.C.

229.title: Ranking Member Smith on News Nation: Trump/Putin Summit Significant Step Backward
229.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash) joined News Nation's Laura Ingle Saturday morning to discuss the aftermath of the meeting between President Trump and Vladimir Putin. Smith said, "This summit was a significant step back and in the effort in the war. The weakness that President Trump showed in front of Putin will simply embolden Putin going forward. Putin got everything he wanted out of this summit, we got nothing, and the prospects of moving towards peace went backwards, without question."

230.title: Ranking Member Smith: Trump Joint Presser with Putin "Incredibly Dangerous"
230.description: Asked about Trump holding a joint press conference with Putin after their meeting in Alaska, House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith said, "If (Trump) does a joint press conference after this, he is elevating Putin's status and stature in this whole conversation and empowering Putin to continue his war. I think Putin is going to have to make some concessions before you give him that level of legitimacy. So, I hope they don't follow through with that."

231.title: Ranking Member Smith: There is Still a Chance to Stop Russia
231.description:
"I am not of the opinion that Russian success is inevitable. people have been saying that since the war started, and they continually run headlong into Ukrainian resistance. They have taken on an appalling level of casualties. Russia has. It is weakening. If we stand strong, I do absolutely believe that Putin can be convinced that he can't win this militarily."

HASC Ranking Member Adam Smith on CNN talking about whether Putin can be made to negotiate and end to the war he started in Ukraine

232.title: Ranking Member Smith: Trump is Being Tested By Putin
232.description:
"Putin wants ... to take over Ukraine one way or the other while continuing to build a better relationship with the U.S. ... That's directly contrary to our interests and European interests and certainly Ukrainian interests. And that's the test for President Trump."

HASC Ranking Member Adam Smith on Trump/Putin meeting today.

233.title: Smith: No Funds for Invading Canada, Greenland, or Panama
233.description:
House Armed Services Committee Democrats Ranking Member Adam Smith introduced an amendment to the fiscal year 2026 National Defense Authorization Act to prohibit the use of funds to invade or seize territory from Canada, the Republic of Panama, or Greenland.

"They have something that we want, so we've decided that it is OK to use force to threaten them. Which makes us no better than Putin... . We should stand up for the principles of international law and not threaten our partners and allies just because we think we can."

234.title: Ranking Member Smith Urges HASC Members to Show Support for Ukraine
234.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith
urges his colleagues in the majority to join House Armed Services Committee Democrats in passing a series of amendments providing increased support to Ukraine.

"You will not get to peace if Putin sees weakness. If he sees that we're walking away from Ukraine, his actions could not possibly be clearer. ... He increases the attacks. He increases all the bombings across Ukraine, and presses forward trying to get to his maximalist goals. We need to show that we support Ukraine in order to stop that from happening. So number one is to try to send a message to the Trump Administration to keep up the fight. Number two is to send a message to Ukraine and Putin."

235.title: Ranking Member Smith Outlines 3 Bipartisan Priorities in the FY26 NDAA
235.description:
House Armed Services Committee Democrats Ranking Member Adam Smith outlined the three main challenges that the bipartisan base bill  text of the Fiscal Year 2026 National Defense Authorization Act seeks to address in his opening remarks at the full committee markup today: 

"We have three big challenges here. One is to make sure we support service members and their families... . Second, we need to reform acquisition ... and fix how slowly the Pentagon moves to acquire critical new technologies... . The third challenge is to get to capacity in terms of critical munitions and critical technologies that we need to make.  

"This bill is incredibly important."

236.title: CNN 7 14 25 captioned
236.description:
"The biggest thing is the significant shift that you're seeing from President Trump. ... The details are obviously important. How many weapons are we going to get to Ukraine? What does a sanctions package look like? But when you think about where President Trump, Vice President Vance, and others were at the start of this administration, criticizing Zelensky, in some cases blaming Ukraine for the war, putting no pressure on Putin, this is a major shift that ... will put us in a better position to get to peace, to put pressure on Putin to stop this war."

House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith discussing Trump's announcement of increased defensive support to Ukraine including Patriot missiles, and threats of sanctions if Russia doesn't negotiate a peace agreement in 50 days.

237.title: Ranking Member Smith: U.S National Security Interests are in Ukraine
237.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined MSNBC's Ali Velshi and discounted Trump's claims that U.S. defense stocks are dangerously low, noting that the fight against Russia in Ukraine now is the greatest threat to U.S. national security we face.

238.title: Ranking Member Smith: Trump Risking American Lives With Budget Bill, Nat Sec by Cutting Off Ukraine
238.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Ali Velshi on MSNBC Saturday to talk about the disastrous consequences of President Trump's budget bill, which will take food and health care from millions of Americans while exploding the national debt by $3.5 trillion, and his decision to cut of military defense support to Ukraine, risking U.S. National Security.

239.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith: What Trump said is "bald-faced lie."
239.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith speaking on CNN called out President Trump's' claims that the U.S. weapons stockpile has been "emptied out." Smith also explained why Trump's decision to cut defense supplies to Ukraine is a threat to U.S. national security.

"What (Trump) just said there is a bald-faced lie. Nothing has been emptied out. Our stockpiles are just about where they were three, three and a half years ago.

... The only way to end this war is to make it clear that Ukraine is going to stop Putin from taking over the country, to force Putin to accept a compromise. Right now, because of everything that Trump has done, Putin doesn't think he has to accept that compromise.

... This is a horrible decision for U.S. national security."

240.title: Ranking Member Smith on MSNBC: Republicans are a Trump cult
240.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) spoke with MSNBC's Ana Cabrera on Thursday about the House GOP passing Trump's budget bill that explodes the debt by $3.5 trillion while ripping away health care and food from the poorest Americans and Trump's continued efforts to undercut Ukraine in favor of Vladimir Putin, including his third decision to halt aid to Ukraine as it fights for its survival amid the worst of Russia's 3+ year assault.

241.title: Ranking Member Smith on GOP Exploding Debt, Taking Health Care and Food Away, and Siding with Putin
241.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined CNN's Erica Hill on the Fourth of July to talk about the ramifications of Trump's budget bill, which will benefit the richest Americans while taking away health care and food from the poorest Americans, and his continued efforts to hamstring Ukraine in favor of Vladimir Putin.

242.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Discusses Trump Turning DoD Into The Department of Culture Wars
242.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined Jen Rubin on her podcast "The Contrarian" to discuss the Trump and his Administration's disastrous management of the Defense Department, including Pete Hegseth leaking battle plans ahead of U.S. military action and prioritizing Trump's right-wing culture war instead of providing for the common defense. 

"Trump wants people who are loyal to Trump. And that's not the same thing as being good at your job."

243.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on Limiting Presidential War Powers in the NDAA
243.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Jen Rubin on her "The Contrarian" podcast and discussed whether the National Defense Authorization Act is likely to include language requiring Trump to fulfil the terms of the War Powers Act before funds can authorized for U.S. military action.

244.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on Presidential War Powers under Trump
244.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined Jen Rubin on her podcast "The Contrarian" to discuss presidential war powers under the Trump Administration and what can be done to try and limit his actions in Iran and elsewhere.

"This president is dangerous … . He creates his own reality. But it is very difficult for Congress to get in the way of presidential authority on these issues. … What we can do is … raise public concern so that the president feels that it's not... something that the people will support.”

286.title: Fit to Serve
286.description:
U.S. Representatives Adam Smith (D-Wash.), Ranking Member of the House Armed Services Committee; Mark Takano (D-Calif.), Chair of the Congressional Equality Caucus (CEC): Chrissy Houlahan (D-Penn.), Ranking Member of the Military Personnel Subcommittee; Sara Jacobs (D-Calif.), Vice Chair of the CEC; and Eric Sorensen (D-Ill.), Co-Chair of the CEC; introduced the Fit To Serve Act today, which affirms the rights of transgender people to serve in the United States Armed Forces by prohibiting discrimination on the basis of gender identity, including a diagnosis or potential diagnosis of gender dysphoria. 

The bill was filed in response to  Executive Order 14183 issued by President Trump on January 27, 2025which effectively bans transgender people from serving in the United States military. On February 20, the Department of Defense (DoD) issued guidance to implement President Trump’s military transgender ban, which resulted in the filing of legal challenges. On March 27, a federal judge issued a nationwide preliminary injunction blocking the DoD from enforcing the ban. On May 6, the Supreme Court stayed the injunction, allowing the Trump Administration to enforce the ban as the lawsuit proceeds. On May 8, DoD set a June 6 deadline for transgender Active Component service members and a July 7 deadline for transgender Reserve Component service members to self-identify for voluntary separations. The military is expected to then initiate involuntary separation procedures for transgender service members once the voluntary self-identification eligibility window concludes.

The Fit to Serve Act seeks to thwart these efforts by affirming the rights of transgender people to serve in the U.S. Armed Forces by:

• Prohibiting the denial of accession, reenlistment, or continuation of service on the basis of gender identity, including a diagnosis or potential diagnosis of gender dysphoria; 

• Prohibiting the involuntary separation of a service member on the basis of gender identity, including a diagnosis or potential diagnosis of gender dysphoria; and

• Ensuring access to medically necessary health care coverage for service members.

We have to be strong to get to that point, but constant conflict with China does not seem like a wise course of action if we ultimately want to deter conflict."

312.title: Ranking Member Smith Calls out Trump Administration for Abandoning European Allies and Partners
312.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) called out the Trump Administration for abandoning Ukraine and allies and partners in Europe and it's inability to understand that China, Russia, Iran, North Korea and other trans national groups are working together to undermine U.S. national security and national defense and stability and democracy worldwide.

313.title: Ranking Member Smith Calls Out Hypocrisy of Trump Administration on Freedom of Speech Attacks
313.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) speaking at today's EUCOM posture hearing called out the hypocrisy of the Trump Administration attacking Europe for failing to honor freedom of speech even as Trump and his Administration work to purge any mention of the contributions of people of color, women, and LGBTQ people from the Defense Department as well as banning books in U.S. military academies.

314.title: Ranking Member Smith Questions Trump Demanding Europe Spend More on Defense Than U.S. Per GDP

315.title: RM Smith Calls Out Acting Assistant Sec Def for Claiming Ceasefire Holds in Putin's war in Ukraine
315.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith called out Katherine Thompson, who performed the duties of Assistant Secretary of Defense for International Security Affairs for the Office of the Secretary Defense, for her claims at the full committee hearing on U.S. military posture and national security challenges in Europe that a ceasefire is holding in Putin’s war in Ukraine. 

“There is no ceasefire, let's just be clear about that. The war is very much ongoing. … to create the notion that there's some kind of ceasefire over there is wildly inaccurate and misleading,” Ranking Member Smith said.

316.title: Ranking Member Smith Asks Gen Cavoli for Update on Ukraine in the East
316.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash), asked Gen. Cavoli, Commander of the U.S. European Command, in the full committee hearing on U.S. military posture and national security challenges in Europe to detail Ukraine's current status as it continues to fight off Putin's full-scale invasion.

317.title: Ranking Member Smith Opening at Hearing on U.S. Military Posture and NatSec Challenges in Europe
317.description:
House Armed Services Committee Chairman Adam Smith (D-Wash.) honored the loss of U.S. service members in Lithuania in his opening remarks at the full committee hearing on U.S. posture in Europe and recognized Ukraine for holding the line as Putin continues his brutal and illegal full-scale invasion of Ukraine, which began three years ago.

"We need to find an end to this war, but you don't find to this war by undermining support for Ukraine and praising Putin."

318.title: Ranking Member Smith Question on Importance of Canada to NORAD and US airspace security
318.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash) asked Gen. Guillot at Tuesday's full committee hearing about what would happen if Canada were to drop out of our binational airspace security program known as NORAD.

319.title: Ranking Member Smith Asks About Cost, Impacts, Timeline for U.S. Troop Deployment to U.S. Border.
319.description: In yesterday’s full committee NORTHCOM and SOUTHCOM hearing, Ranking Member Smith asked the witnesses to detail how many DoD personnel are committed to the southern border, the cost of the operation, and if there is an end goal in sight.

320.title: Ranking Member Smith Asks About Trump Threats Impacting NORAD and U.S. Airspace
320.description: In yesterday’s full committee NORTHCOM and SOUTHCOM hearing, Ranking Member Smith asked Gen. Guillot about the U.S./Canda air defense partnership and if Canada were to drop out of the NORAD program, what impacts that might have on our ability to protect our air space from adversaries.

321.title: Ranking Member Smith on Acquisition Reform at NORTHCOM SOUTHCOM hearing
321.description: In yesterday’s full committee NORTHCOM and SOUTHCOM hearing, Ranking Member Smith asked the witnesses to explain the acquisition hurdles they face and what Congress can do to help alleviate the problem and ensure greater innovation in our national defense.

322.title: Ranking Member Smith Full Committee Opener for NORTHCOM SOUTHCOM Posture Hearing
322.description:
In yesterday’s full committee NORTHCOM and SOUTHCOM hearing, Ranking Member Smith talked about security challenges to the region, including organized crime involved in human and drug trafficking and the malign influence of China, Russia, and Iran. 

Smith also questioned the cost and efficacy of the mass deployment of U.S. troops to the southern border now that illegal border crossings are significantly down, and the potentially devastating impact that President Trump’s threats of annexation and tariffs could have on our ability to work with allies and friends like Canada and Panama, which we need to face a myriad of national security threats.

323.title: Ranking Member Smith on the Need for a More Robust Response on Signalgate
323.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined House Democratic Caucus Chair Pete Aguilar (D-Calif.) to talk about the need for the House Armed Services Committee Majority to agree to call a hearing with Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth to get to the bottom of Signalgate and to ensure it never happens again.

324.title: Ranking Member Smith on Trump Admin Not Respecting Congressional Oversight
324.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined House Democratic Caucus Chair Pete Aguilar (D-Calif.) and was asked whether the committee had received any response from the Trump Administration to Smith's requests for information to understand how the Administration leaked highly sensitive military attack plans ahead of the operation on the Signal app and what they were doing to ensure such a breach never happens again.

325.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Talks About Signal Gate at House Dem Press Caucus
325.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined House Democratic Caucus Chair Pete Aguilar (D-Calif.) to talk about the serous NatSec implications stemming from President Trump's top advisors sharing military attack plans on the unsecured Signal messaging app ahead of military action and the primary concerns that remain.

326.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on Musk Buying Votes, Trump Fumbling Could Drag U.S. into War with Iran
326.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash) joined NewsNation's Anna Kooiman on Sunday to talk about Musk buying votes and President Trump's threats to bomb Iran risking U.S. going to war in the region.

RM Smith also discussed Trump being played for a fool by Putin in botched ceasefire attempt and the fallout his autocratic approach threatens to unleash on the U.S. economy and national security.

327.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith on Signalgate Fallout, Trump Making America Weak
327.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Melissa Murray on MSNBC Saturday morning to discuss the ongoing fallout from Trump's National Security team sharing military battle plans on the unsecured Signal messaging app hours before the operation.

Smith talked about the impacts on friends and allies who helped provide the information for the US strikes on Houthis in Yemen and U.S. service members, including military pilots, who are expressing concern and frustration that the Trump Administration may cause another security breach that could result in troops being killed and operational failure.

Smith also discussed how Trump's refusal to admit to the threat the breach poses and to hold his advisors to account is weakening U.S. National Security, much as Trump's economic and social policies are making America weak.

328.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Talks to Jose Diaz Balart About Signalgate, Calls for Hegseth to be fired
328.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith joined Jose Diaz Balart to talk about the threat that Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth's ignorance of how to handle sensitive military information poses to service members, mission success, and U.S. national security. 

Smith called for Hegseth to be fired if he doesn't resign and also filed a resolution of inquiry in the House Armed Services Committee for the President and the Department of Defense to to turn over all communications on the operation against the Houthis that Hegseth and other Senior Trump officials shared on the unsecured Signal messaging app hours before military action.

329.title: Ranking Member Smith Calls for Hegseth Removal, Trump and DoD to Turn Over Info on Leak of Mil Plans
329.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) spoke with Katy Tur on MSNBC today about the ongoing fallout of President Trump's top national security advisors leaking military plans ahead of an operation on an unsecure public messaging app. Smith called for Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth to resign or be fired over Signalgate and called for the Defense Department provide a classified briefing to the Armed Services Committee after House Republicans refused to call a hearing with Hegseth or other Trump Administration officials.

330.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Calls for Sec Def Hegseth to Testify Before Armed Services Committee
330.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined MSNBC's Chris Hayes today to talk about his letter to Chairman Mike Rogers calling for Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth to be called in to testify about The Atlantic reports that he and other top Trump Nat Sec officials discussed classified military operations in an unsecured, public messaging app before military operations in Yemen, risking the lives of U.S. service members and the compromised the operation. In the letter, signed by all House Armed Services Committee Democrats, the Members ask that the hearing be held within the upcoming three-week congressional session.

331.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Says Hegseth Should Resign or be Fired for Signalgate
331.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) called for Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth to resign and said Hegseth and any other Defense Department official who took part in sharing highly sensitive military information ahead of a military operation that could have resulted in deaths of U.S. service members and compromising the mission on an open-source group messaging app should be fired.

332.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith: "Trump, Hegseth are Way Crazy Incompetent"
332.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined MSNBC's Jonathan Capehart on The Last Word to discuss the breach of highly sensitive and classified information on a nonsecure public messaging app hours before military operations were carried out in Yemen and the national security implications for the United States.

333.title: Rep. Adam Smith Calls out Trump, Waltz, Hegseth for Lying About Breach of Military Plans on Signal
333.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined CNN's Boris Sanchez to discuss the fallout from The Alantic's report regarding the Trump National Security team including the magazine's editor in a text messaging group chat that reportedly included classified or sensitive information about the bombing campaign in Yemen hours before it began on the unclassified and unsecure system. 

Smith called on President Trump, National Security Advisor Mike Waltz, and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth to stop lying about the security breach to the American public, explain how such an incompetent error occurred, and detail how exactly they will ensure it never happens again. Smith also said House Democrats are requesting a transcript of the messages and called on his Republican colleagues to fulfill their duty and conduct oversight of the massive breach, which could have resulted in the deaths of U.S. service members.

334.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Calls out Trump Admin Leak of Military Action Plans
334.description:
When you hire based on sycophancy and loyalty f* ups are going to happen. This endangerment of national security is an unbelievable disaster. 
 
We need to put pressure on the Trump Administration to get back to focusing on competency, get back to focusing on serving the American people instead of just focusing on going after Donald Trump’s enemies and sucking up to Donald Trump. We need competent government. The Trump Administration is not giving that to us.
 
- House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash) responding to The Atlantic's report that the Trump Admin texted Editor Jeffrey Goldberg plans for U.S. military strikes on Yemen in advance of military action.

335.title: Rep Smith on President Trump Invoking Alien Enemies Act, Attacking Federal Workforce
335.description: House Armed Services Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Laura Ingle on News Nation on Sunday morning to discuss President Trump invoking the Alien Enemies Act to conduct mass deportations and the potential negative impacts on the rule of law in the United States as well as Trump's ongoing attacks on the federal workforce, hampering their ability to provide critically needed services to American veterans, seniors, and more.

336.title: Rep Smith on Russia Refusing 30-day Ceasefire, Continuing Resolution Vote
336.description: House Armed Services Committee Chairman Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined CNN Friday morning to talk about the latest on Putin refusing the 30-day ceasefire with Ukraine and the upcoming Senate vote on the continuing resolution.

337.title: Rep Courtney Opening Statement for SPF Hearing on U.S. Shipbuilding
337.description:
In his opening remarks at today’s SPF hearing on the state of U.S. shipbuilding, Subcommittee Ranking Member Joe Courtney (D-Conn) talked about the crucial role the sea services fulfill in securing peace and the need to address the increased demand for Navy ships and submarines that far outstrips our supply. 

Pursuing innovation and supporting education and training in the shipbuilding trades are key to meeting that demand and strengthening our national defense, even as the threat of tariffs continue to loom over America's domestic shipbuilding industry.

338.title: Ranking Member Smith on Trump Undermining Ukraine
338.description:
"Putin is the one who doesn't want to negotiate and Trump's putting all of the pressure on Zelensky. It is not just a betrayal of democracy and a betrayal of our commitment to Ukraine, it's stupid."

I'll believe sanctions when I see them.

339.title: Ranking Member Smith on Trump's attacks on federal workforce, Ukraine on Morning Joe
339.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Rep. Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Jonathan Lemire on Morning Joe Friday to talk about the impact of President Trump and Musk's assault on the federal workforce, particularly veteran workers and veteran services; the looming government budget showdown; and Trump undermining Ukraine as it fights for its survival against Russia's illegal and brutal full-scale invasion.

340.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Calls Out Trump Cutting Intel Sharing for Ukraine
340.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Rep. Adam Smith (D-Wash.) spoke out against President Trump's latest move to side with Putin and hobble Ukraine--cutting off life-saving intelligence sharing--and called on Republicans who support Ukraine to finally out.

341.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Discusses Ukraine, Russia Peace Negotiations on News Nation
341.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined News Nation's Connell McShane on Tuesday to talk about the latest developments on the peace process with Ukraine and Russia amid Trump removing U.S. military support for Ukraine.

342.title: Rep Adam Smith on Trump Zelensky Oval Office Meeting and Peace Negotiations for Ukraine and Russia
342.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined News Nation's Laura Ingle to discuss the contentious meeting between Ukrainian President Zelenskyy and U.S. President Trump and what the Trump Administration is failing to recognize at least one core component needed to negotiate peace between Ukraine and Russia, which is to provide Ukraine with security guarantees much as the U.S. does with Israel, and to recognize Putin invaded Ukraine illegally and unjustly and is the aggressor.

343.title: Rep Adam Smith Talks About Trump Admin Sending More Troops to the Border, Attacking Fed Workers
343.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined News Nation's Laura Ingle Saturday morning to discuss the latest surge of U.S. troops to the southern border and Trump's and Musk's continued campaign of harassment against federal workers while slashing the workforce in key agencies without any focus on job performance or achieving real efficiency or cost savings.

344.title: 20260226 Smith DOGE question subtitled
344.description: House Armed Services Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) spoke at the full committee hearing on strengthening the defense industrial base, workforce, and production lines about the DOGE approach causing chaos at the Pentagon and urged the Department to instead push for a change in culture to address the onerous requirements process and free up Pentagon employees so that they can more efficiently and effectively do their jobs.

345.title: Ranking Member Smith Calls Out DOGE Chaos at Pentagon
345.description: House Armed Services Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) spoke at the full committee hearing on strengthening the defense industrial base, workforce, and production lines about the DOGE approach sowing chaos and confusion at the Pentagon and called for a change in culture, changing the requirements process, and freeing up Pentagon employees so that they can more efficiently and effectively do their jobs.

346.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Full Committee Hearing Opener on Strengthening the DIB
346.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) delivered opening remarks at the full committee hearing on "Strengthening America’s Defense Industrial Base, Workforce, and Production Lines to Deter War." 

In his remarks, Ranking Member smith called for greater innovation and ensuring the military services can field capabilities more quickly and about the lack of efficiency in acquisitions programs that take too long to develop, produce, and become operational. Smith also discussed his dire concerns of the impacts of President Trump's DOGE attacks on the federal workforce and Pentagon that are creating chaos rather than efficiency.

347.title: Rep Adam Smith on DOGE Attacking the Pentagon
347.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined MSNBC's Ana Cabrera to talk about Trump and Musk using DOGE to smash the federal government not for efficiency, but to garner more power and use it to their financial and personal benefit, particularly in regards to the Department of Defense.

348.title: Rep. Adam Smith on MSNBC Discussing How to Stop Trump Dismantling Goverment and Democracy
348.description: House Armed Services Ranking Member Rep. Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined MSNBC's Ana Cabrera Tuesday morning to talk about what Democrats and Republicans need to do to stop President Trump and Elon Musk from dismantling the federal workforce and representative government to consolidate power--which is the real purpose of their so-called efficiency efforts.

349.title: Rep Adam Smith Discusses DOGE impacts on Pentagon, Immigration, and Ukraine
349.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Rep. Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined King 5's Sunday broadcast to discuss the fallout from Trump's and Musk's DOGE attacks on the federal workforce, including the Pentagon; the use of military sites for housing migrants; and the war in Ukraine and the prospects for peace negotiations given Trump's weakness with Putin.

350.title: Rep Adam Smith on Dangers of Trump Government Worker Cuts, Democrats Fighting Back, and Gaza
350.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) went on NewsNation Saturday morning to discuss the impacts of Trump's hatchet job on federal government agencies and employees, how Democrats can better message their efforts to fight back, and the release of more hostages from Gaza, including an American.

351.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Joins Meet the Press Now to Discuss Trump's Weakness on Ukraine
351.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) was on Meet the Press NOW to discuss the Trump Administration's weak position on Ukraine and NATO, including Sec Def Hegseth's and Vice President Vance's recent comments at the Munich Security Conference.

352.title: Ranking Member Smith Delivers Opening Remarks at HASC Hearing on Global Threats
352.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Rep. Adam Smith (D-Wash.) spoke about the challenge the U.S. faces as global competitors and adversaries work together to undermine U.S. influence and the need for greater efficiency and effectiveness at the Pentagon, particularly when it comes to defense acquisitions.

353.title: Rep Adam Smith and Kate Bolduan Discuss DOGE Impacts on Pentagon
353.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined CNN's Kate Bolduan to discuss concerns about Trump, Musk and DOGE going after the Pentagon with a meat ax for personal reasons rather than seeking real efficiencies.

354.title: Rep Adam Smith Joins CNN's Kate Bolduan to Discuss Fallout From Trump Shut Down of USAID
354.description: House Armed Services Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Kate Bolduan on CNN to discuss the disastrous fallout of Trump's stop work orders that has halted all USAID programs, leaving starving people without food and U.S. government workers without jobs and unsure of their futures.

355.title: Rep Adam Smith on Ukraine, Trump Autocracy on NewsNation
355.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Morning in America host Hena Doba on NewsNation to discuss Ukraine and the impact of Trump's agenda and the autocracy he is creating with Elon Musk.

356.title: Rep. Adam Smith Joins Seattle Fox News to Discuss Air Disaster Response
356.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Fox Local in Seattle Friday morning to discuss the investigation into the fatal crash involving a commercial airliner and an Army helicopter over the Potomac Wednesday night and what the House Armed Services Committee is doing to ensure that investigation is conducted thoroughly and steps are taken to help avoid similar tragedies in the future.

357.title: Ranking Member Adam Smith Welcomes New and Returning House Armed Services Committee Members
357.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) welcomed new and returning committee members in Wednesday’s first full committee markup for the 119th Congress, emphasizing the key to the committee’s success in passing the National Defense Authorization Act for the past 64 years is its “absolute commitment to bipartisanship and … absolute commitment to getting our bill done every year.” 

“We are very focused on getting the bill done because we understand how important our mission is—exercising oversight of the Pentagon and making sure the men and women who serve in the military have the tools they need to perform their mission,” Smith said.

358.title: Rep Adam Smith Explains Why Pete Hegseth is Unsuitable for the Job of Secretary of Defense
358.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Rep Adam Smith spoke recently about the unsuitability of President-elect Trump's nomination for Secretary of Defense, Pete Hegseth. From his lack of experience to charges of mistreatment of women and alcoholism "Hegseth himself is deeply alarming."

359.title: Rep Adam Smith Discusses HASC Priorities in the 119th Congress
359.description:
House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined Greta Brawner on C-SPAN's Washington Journal on the first day of the 119th Congress to discuss the four main priorities for the HASC in the new Congress: improving the Pentagon’s ability to buy new, innovative technology; increasing production of critical munitions; improving U.S. military recruitment and retention; and working with allies and partners so that we can better face challenges and threats coming from China, Russia, Iran, North Korea and global extremists. 

They also discussed the challenges of maintaining support for Ukraine as it continues to fight to defend itself and keeping the bipartisan nature of the committee intact with the incoming Trump Administration.

360.title: 20230703 RM Smith on Morning Joe discussing Indo-Pacific CODEL and Russia's invasion of Ukraine
360.description: House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith (D-Wash.) joined MSNBC's Morning Joe program to discuss the committee's bipartisan congressional delegation (CODEL) that traveled to the INDOPACOM HQ in Hawaii as well as Guam, the Philippines, Taiwan, and Japan. The CODEL met with senior officials at every location to discuss security issues in the Indo-Pacific region for the United States and allies and partners.

361.title: 20230529 Smith Meet the Press NOW Debt Ceiling
361.description: Congressman Adam Smith (D-Wash.), Ranking Member of the House Armed Services Committee, joined Meet the Press NOW's Kristen Welker to discuss the budget agreement led by President Biden and the fallout that would result to the U.S.'s national defense and economy if Republican leadership fails to avoid default.

106.title: Chairman Thornberry Lays Out Agenda at AEI
106.description:
Ahead of the State of the Union address, House Armed Services Committee Chairman Mac Thornberry (R-TX) laid out his agenda for the Committee in the 114th Congress at the American Enterprise Institute. Additionally, the Chairman sat down with Senator Jim Talent to discuss the proper role of Congress in national security policymaking, the need for a strong US military, and the importance of a reformed defense process that quickly and agilely meets the needs of America’s troops.
 
Key Excerpts:
…”The first, and I believe foremost, job of the federal government is to defend the country
and our people. And Congress has a unique and irreplaceable role in carrying out that duty.” … 
 
“In Article I, Section 8 of the Constitution, at least six specific duties were placed upon the
House and Senate. Through those authorities, Congress determines the size, shape, and
soul of the military. The President, then, determines how to use it.” …
 
“As long as I am privileged to hold this job, defense reform will be a priority – not for its
own sake, but for the sake of ensuring our military is as prepared as possible for the wide
array of threats we face today and for the unknown security challenges which confront us
tomorrow.”

109.title: McKeon Delivers Farewell Address to House
109.description:
Washington, D.C. - Rep. Howard P. "Buck" McKeon, Chairman of the House Armed Services Committee, made the following statement regarding final passage of the Fiscal Year 2015 National Defense Authorization Act Conference Report and the end of his tenure in Congress. 
"I want to thank the other committees who worked closely with us all year and members of the Armed Services Committee once again. As you have heard, this legislation addresses a wide array of policy issues, including supporting operations in Afghanistan, funding the war against ISIL in the Iraq and Syria, reinforcing our capabilities in the Pacific, and maintaining this Nation’s nuclear deterrent.  But many challenges remain.

"Next year, the Armed Services Committee will be in excellent hands. Chairman-elect Thornberry and Ranking Member Smith have their work cut out. But they are both up to the task. I hope sometime next year a compromise can come to this floor that will end sequestration.  There isn’t some magical solution that Republicans can support and the President can sign without sacrifice on both sides.  

"When that solution comes, it will be a tough vote on both sides.  For some of my colleagues, it might be a fatal vote.  I pray that you will hold this thought in your hearts when that vote comes: Remember the great sacrifice our troops are making around the world.  

"Right now, they are walking patrol in the mountains of Afghanistan. They are at sea within missile range of Iran. They are flying wingtip-to-wingtip against Russia bombers over the North Sea. They are nose to nose with the North Koreans. They are sweating in the equatorial heat of Africa, fighting a horrible disease. They are standing on the sand of Iraq, risking everything against a brutal enemy.
They take those risks, they make those sacrifices, because of you. They do it for you. They do it for us. For their families, for their flag. For our freedom.

"And how we have repaid them? With equipment that is falling apart. By laying them off while they’re off in war zones. By docking their pay and their medical benefits. By throwing them out of the service and onto a broken economy.

"Lord Byron said “they never fail, who die in a great cause.” I’ve met our forces on the battlefields of Iraq and Afghanistan, dirty and sweaty from fighting. I’ve watched too many families spend long months waiting for the deployed to come home. I’ve seen too many heroes put into the ground. 
They never failed us. Not once.

So shame on us, if we’re unwilling to pay back the debt we owe them. Shame on all of us, from the White House down, if we cannot make far less a sacrifice on their behalf. 

My road in Congress is coming to an end. It will be on the next Congress and the President to make these injustices right.  So please, show our troops the respect they deserve. Give them the tools they need. Help keep them safe. Honor their service, with your service. I know you will do the right thing. 

"I am in the twilight of a 22-year career in Congress. I’ve come to know many of you as friends, and many of you as my family. 

"To the Armed Services Committee staff, that’s minority and majority: you are veterans, you are professionals, you are tireless… but I just think of you as the best. 

"No one comes close, and you have humbled me with minds that are as full and pure as your hearts.
I owe you all a thank you. Thank you for trusting me with the awesome responsibility of this Chairmanship. Thank you for entrusting me with the safety and well-being of our Armed Forces. 

"Now, I’m a McKeon. So I’ll part this chamber with an old Irish Blessing. 
May the road rise up to meet you, 
…may the wind be ever at your back. 
May the sun shine warm upon your face and the rain fall softly on your fields. 
And until we meet again, may God hold you in the hollow of his hand. 
To this great body, and to our troops –wherever you may be—may God bless you and keep you, and may God Bless America.

"Mr. Speaker, for the last time, I yield back the balance of my time."

139.title: Chairman of the Joint Chiefs on more defense cuts: "We can't give you one more dollar."
139.description:
Last week, President Obama opened the door to a temporary fix of sequestration.  When asked to elaborate on what that fix would look like, Spokesman Jay Carney again advocated paying down sequester with more defense cuts. 

Today, testifying with all the service chiefs, General Martin Dempsey, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, was asked about the magnitude of additional cuts the military can endure.  His important answer: "We can't give you another dollar."

Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, General Martin Dempsey:

"We built a strategy last year that we said we could execute and absorb $487 billion. I can't sit here today and guarantee you that if you take another $175 billion that that strategy remains solvent....

The question I would ask this committee: What do you want your military to do? If you want it to be doing what it's doing today, then we can't give you another dollar. If you want us to do something less than that, we're all there with you and we'll figure it out."

140.title: House, Senate Armed Services Committees Introduce Bill to Protect National Security
140.description:
House Armed Services Committee Chairman Howard P. "Buck" McKeon was joined at a press conference today by HASC Vice Chairman Mac Thornberry, Tactical Air and Land Forces Subcommittee Chairman Michael Turner, and Senators Inhofe, Ayotte, McCain, and Graham, were they unveiled the Down Payment to Protect National Security Act of 2013. 

McKeon made the following statement on this proposal: 
 
"Yesterday, the President opened the door to a short term resolution of sequestration, but his proposal is unbalanced, irresponsible and unacceptable. Moreover, he never suggested that his proposal was intended to buy time to fix the real drivers of our debt. 

"The Down Payment to Protect National Security Act of 2013 would prevent a further round of cuts in Fiscal Year 2013 from hitting our military as a result of sequestration, beyond the $46 billion reduction already imposed over the last two years as part of the President's budget-driven defense strategy.  The President's first round of cuts significantly reduced military end strength, impacted force readiness, and curtailed modernization.  Another round of cuts required as a result of full sequestration would devastate our Armed Forces."
 
"Republicans don't want to go into sequester, but the President will force us there if he insists on a plan that shirks his responsibility to the troops, that is bad for national security and bad for the economy.

"There are better ways to resolve the President's sequester plan. I am proud to join Senators Kelly Ayotte and Jim Inhofe as well other HASC and SASC Members in promoting this common sense responsible plan to restore readiness, resolve sequestration, and buy time to negotiate a truly balanced solution that addresses the real drivers of our debt."

EXCERPT: While concentrating on operational matters of their respective services, the schools provide an important, early joint education through more than the subjects taught.  The use of other service faculty and attendance by other service, international, and interagency students in these seminar based courses provide a broadening perspective.  The witnesses will understand then, our interest in questions of faculty quality and diversity of experience, and the ability of the services to support each other with excellent faculty and students.  Without a solid mix of other service and agency faculty and students, none of your institutions can provide a credible joint education.   I would appreciate hearing both your success stories and your obstacles in attaining these goals as you testify today.
